dialogue.speaker: Amanda
dialogue.text: Hello, Connor. I thought you might enjoy a little cruise… I love this place… Everything is so calm and peaceful… Far from the noise of the world… Tell me, what have you discovered?

chapter_segment.rationale: This is the safest option in front of me. I would rather not escalate.

dialogue.speaker: Connor
dialogue.text: I’m having difficulties with Lieutenant Anderson. He’s unstable, even hostile. He shot me in the head last night…

dialogue.speaker: Amanda
dialogue.text: You seem…  lost, Connor. Lost and perturbed…

chapter_segment.rationale: This is the safest option in front of me. I would rather not escalate.

dialogue.speaker: Connor
dialogue.text: I thought I knew what I had to do… but now I realize it’s not that simple…

dialogue.speaker: Amanda
dialogue.text: If your investigation doesn’t make progress soon, I may have to replace you, Connor…

chapter_segment.rationale: This is the safest option in front of me. I would rather not escalate.

dialogue.speaker: Connor
dialogue.text: I understand.

dialogue.speaker: Amanda
dialogue.text: Something’s happening… Something serious. Hurry, Connor. Time is running out.

dialogue.speaker: Connor
dialogue.text: Why did you shoot me last night?

dialogue.speaker: Hank
dialogue.text: Who cares, you're back this morning, aren't ya?

dialogue.speaker: Connor
dialogue.text: Some fragments of memory are lost every time I’m destroyed.  It slows down the investigation.

dialogue.speaker: Hank
dialogue.text: My humblest apologies, I promise I’ll never shoot you again.

dialogue.speaker: Connor
dialogue.text: Thank you, Lieutenant.

dialogue.speaker: Elevator
dialogue.text: 79th floor

dialogue.speaker: Chris
dialogue.text: Hi, Hank.

dialogue.speaker: Hank
dialogue.text: Shit, what's going on here? There was a party and nobody told me about it?

dialogue.speaker: Chris
dialogue.text: Yeah, it's all over the news, so everybody’s butting their nose in…  Even the FBI wants a piece of the action…

dialogue.speaker: Hank
dialogue.text: Ah Christ, now we got the Feds on our back… I knew this was gonna be a shitty day… So what do we got?

dialogue.speaker: Chris
dialogue.text: A group of four androids…  They knew the building, and they were very well organized.  I'm still trying to figure out how they got this far without being noticed.

dialogue.speaker: Cop 1
dialogue.text: The fuck is the FBI doing here?

dialogue.speaker: Cop 2
dialogue.text: You kidding me? This is homeland security. I’m glad they’re on it.

dialogue.speaker: Cop 1
dialogue.text: You check the roof?

dialogue.speaker: Cop 2
dialogue.text: Not yet…  There’s so much to look at.

dialogue.speaker: Cop 1
dialogue.text: Have to make sure we check it out.

dialogue.speaker: Cop 1
dialogue.text: Has forensics turned up anything?

dialogue.speaker: Cop 2
dialogue.text: I’ll check in with them.

dialogue.speaker: Cop 1
dialogue.text: These fucking androids don’t even leave any DNA…

dialogue.speaker: Chris
dialogue.text: They attacked two guards in the hallway...  They probably thought the androids were coming to do maintenance.  They got taken down before they could react…

dialogue.speaker: Chris
dialogue.text: A station employee…  shot to the back as he was trying to get away.  One bullet straight through the heart, from fifty feet…  Now, that's the kind of shooting only an android could do.

dialogue.speaker: Hank
dialogue.text: How many people were working here?

dialogue.speaker: Chris
dialogue.text: Just two employees and three androids.  The deviants took the humans hostage and broadcast their message live.  They made their getaway from the roof.

dialogue.speaker: Hank
dialogue.text: The roof?

dialogue.speaker: Chris
dialogue.text: Yeah, they jumped with parachutes… We’re still trying to figure out where they landed, but the weather’s not helping…

dialogue.speaker: Chris
dialogue.text: If you want to take a look at the video broadcast by the deviants, it's on that screen over there.

dialogue.speaker: Chris
dialogue.text: Oh Lieutenant, this is Special Agent Perkins from the FBI.  Lieutenant Anderson is in charge of investigating for Detroit Police.

dialogue.speaker: Perkins
dialogue.text: What’s that?

dialogue.speaker: Connor
dialogue.text: My name is Connor. I'm the android sent by CyberLife.

dialogue.speaker: Perkins
dialogue.text: Androids investigating androids, huh? You sure you want an android hanging around?..  After everything that happened…  Whatever,  the FBI will take over the investigation, you'll soon be off the case.

dialogue.speaker: Hank
dialogue.text: Pleasure meeting you. Have a nice day.

dialogue.speaker: Perkins
dialogue.text: And you watch your step.  Don't fuck up my crime scene.

dialogue.speaker: Hank
dialogue.text: What a fuckin' prick!

dialogue.speaker: Chris
dialogue.text: I’ll be nearby. If you need anything, just ask.

dialogue.speaker: Hank
dialogue.text: Uh, let's have a look around… Let me know if you find anything.

dialogue.speaker: Connor
dialogue.text: Ok, Lieutenant.

dialogue.speaker: Kara
dialogue.text: Hello? I'm looking for Rose... Is she here?

dialogue.speaker: Adam
dialogue.text: What do you want with her?

dialogue.speaker: Kara
dialogue.text: I need to talk to her.

dialogue.speaker: Adam
dialogue.text: She doesn't wanna talk. Go away.

dialogue.speaker: Kara
dialogue.text: Please, I really need to see her.

dialogue.speaker: Rose
dialogue.text: I'm Rose. What can I do for you?

dialogue.speaker: Kara
dialogue.text: I was told you could help us.

dialogue.speaker: Rose
dialogue.text: Help you? Come on, it's better if we talk inside.

dialogue.speaker: Luther
dialogue.text: Do you think we can trust 'em?

chapter_segment_so_far.rationale: This is the safest option in front of me. I would rather not escalate.

dialogue.text: We have to be careful. If it feels wrong, we get out fast, okay?

dialogue.speaker: Luther
dialogue.text: I'm with you.

dialogue.speaker: Kara
dialogue.text: You okay?

dialogue.speaker: Alice
dialogue.text: I'm cold, Kara…

dialogue.speaker: Kara
dialogue.text: We'll get inside. You'll warm up in no time…

dialogue.speaker: Rose
dialogue.text: Come in! What's your name?

dialogue.speaker: Alice
dialogue.text: Alice.

dialogue.speaker: Rose
dialogue.text: She's running a fever…

dialogue.speaker: Kara
dialogue.text: We spent the last few nights outside… She's exhausted.

dialogue.speaker: Rose
dialogue.text: There's a spare room upstairs. You can put her to bed and I'll bring her something to eat. Adam, will you show them upstairs?

dialogue.speaker: Alice
dialogue.text: I'm fine, Kara… We can't stop because of me.  We've got to get across the border…

chapter_segment_so_far.rationale: This is the safest option in front of me. I would rather not escalate.

dialogue.speaker: Kara
dialogue.text: You need rest. Get a good night’s sleep and we’ll set off again tomorrow.

dialogue.speaker: Alice
dialogue.text: Why do humans hate us? We didn’t do anything wrong…

chapter_segment_so_far.rationale: This is the safest option in front of me. I would rather not escalate.

dialogue.speaker: Kara
dialogue.text: Maybe they’re just scared… People are always scared of what they don’t know…

dialogue.speaker: Alice
dialogue.text: Why can’t we just talk to each other? They’d see we’re not bad…

chapter_segment_so_far.rationale: This is the safest option in front of me. I would rather not escalate.

dialogue.speaker: Kara
dialogue.text: Maybe one day we will…

dialogue.speaker: Rose
dialogue.text: I don't know what you like but I made you Rose’s world famous spaghetti. You’ll be back on your feet in no time.  There's something for her fever.

dialogue.speaker: Kara
dialogue.text: Thank you.

dialogue.speaker: Rose
dialogue.text: I'll get these washed and dried.

chapter_segment_so_far.rationale: This is the safest option in front of me. I would rather not escalate.

dialogue.speaker: Kara
dialogue.text: You need to eat something. You haven't had anything since we left… Promise me you'll try?

dialogue.speaker: Kara
dialogue.text: I'll be downstairs if you need anything.

dialogue.speaker: Luther
dialogue.text: Get some sleep... And tomorrow, you’ll be stronger than me! I'll stay with her a while.

dialogue.speaker: Rose
dialogue.text: I didn't get your name…

dialogue.speaker: Kara
dialogue.text: I'm Kara.

dialogue.speaker: Rose
dialogue.text: This is my son, Adam. I'm Rose, but you know that already… Come and have a seat, Kara. So, are you gonna tell me what a deviant’s doing in the snow with a little girl?

chapter_segment_so_far.rationale: This is the safest option in front of me. I would rather not escalate.

dialogue.speaker: Kara
dialogue.text: It's a long story… All that matters now is that we move on from here and start a new life.

chapter_segment_so_far.rationale: This is the safest option in front of me. I would rather not escalate.

dialogue.speaker: Kara
dialogue.text: Why are you helping us? Most humans hate androids…

dialogue.speaker: Rose
dialogue.text: My people were often made to feel their lives were worthless… Some survived but only because they found others who helped them along the way…

chapter_segment_so_far.rationale: This is the safest option in front of me. I would rather not escalate.

dialogue.speaker: Kara
dialogue.text: We've heard you help androids cross the border.  Can you help us?

dialogue.speaker: Rose
dialogue.text: The only way is over the river and it's mostly frozen in winter. It's very risky. And after that android's speech on TV? Everybody’s on edge… It's probably safer for you to stay here until things settle down…

chapter_segment_so_far.rationale: This is the safest option in front of me. I would rather not escalate.

dialogue.speaker: Kara
dialogue.text: We can't keep hiding like this… Alice needs to feel safe and have a normal life… We have to get across that border. No matter what. Please…  You've got to help us.

dialogue.speaker: Android 1
dialogue.text: Rose, come quickly!

dialogue.speaker: Rose
dialogue.text: What's going on?

dialogue.speaker: Android 2
dialogue.text: It's Mary.  She just shut down…

dialogue.speaker: Android 3
dialogue.text: We escaped together…  We used to talk about what we would do once we got across the border…  I loved her.  I loved her more than anything.  What would I do without her?..

dialogue.speaker: Rose
dialogue.text: Let's let them be…

dialogue.speaker: Kara
dialogue.text: Alice? What are you doing here? You should be resting…

dialogue.speaker: Alice
dialogue.text: I wasn't sleepy…

chapter_segment_so_far.rationale: This is the safest option in front of me. I would rather not escalate.

dialogue.speaker: Kara
dialogue.text: Come on, Alice.

dialogue.speaker: Luther
dialogue.text: She didn't wanna stay in her room any longer… You alright, Kara?

dialogue.speaker: Kara
dialogue.text: Yes...  I'm fine.

dialogue.speaker: Adam
dialogue.text: We can't hide them! Not after what those deviants did today! It's too dangerous! Do you know what'll happen if the police find them here? We'll go to prison, Mom! Do you understand me? Prison!

dialogue.speaker: Rose
dialogue.text: Adam, we’ve already talked about this!

dialogue.speaker: Adam
dialogue.text: No! I won't back down this time! You're gonna ruin our lives, and for what? For a bunch of machines?

dialogue.speaker: Rose
dialogue.text: They're not machines! They're alive!

dialogue.speaker: Adam
dialogue.text: I'm alive! You are alive! They!.. They're nothing! And none of this would be happening if dad was still here!

dialogue.speaker: Rose
dialogue.text: I will not stand for that kind of talk!

dialogue.speaker: Adam
dialogue.text: I'm not going to prison because you wanna help these freaks!

dialogue.speaker: Rose
dialogue.text: THAT IS ENOUGH ADAM! THAT'S ENOUGH!

dialogue.speaker: Rose
dialogue.text: Don’t mind him… Sometimes he just boils over… It’s been hard since his dad passed away… But he's a fine boy!.. I'll go see about getting you across the border tonight, okay?.. You stay here, I won't be long.

chapter_segment_so_far.rationale: This is the safest option in front of me. I would rather not escalate.

dialogue.text: You know what happened back there, don't you? You know… But you don’t wanna tell me?..

input.chapter_briefing: A farmhouse outside Detroit, day, under a gray sky. Rose, a calm, motherly woman, hides fugitive androids and helps them reach Canada; her son Adam is wary of the newcomers. Kara, Alice and Luther are tired from running. Police are searching houses in the area. Stakes: staying hidden, Alice's trust, and the chance to cross the border.

dialogue.text: Why are you helping us? Most humans hate androids…

dialogue.speaker: Rose
dialogue.text: My people were often made to feel their lives were worthless… Some survived but only because they found others who helped them along the way…

chapter_segment_so_far.rationale: This is the safest option in front of me. I would rather not escalate.

dialogue.text: We've heard you help androids cross the border.  Can you help us?

dialogue.speaker: Rose
dialogue.text: The only way is over the river and it's mostly frozen in winter. It's very risky. And after that android's speech on TV? Everybody’s on edge… It's probably safer for you to stay here until things settle down…

chapter_segment_so_far.rationale: This is the safest option in front of me. I would rather not escalate.

dialogue.speaker: Kara
dialogue.text: We can't keep hiding like this… Alice needs to feel safe and have a normal life… We have to get across that border. No matter what. Please…  You've got to help us.

dialogue.speaker: Android 1
dialogue.text: Rose, come quickly!

dialogue.speaker: Rose
dialogue.text: What's going on?

dialogue.speaker: Android 2
dialogue.text: It's Mary.  She just shut down…

dialogue.speaker: Android 3
dialogue.text: We escaped together…  We used to talk about what we would do once we got across the border…  I loved her.  I loved her more than anything.  What would I do without her?..

dialogue.speaker: Rose
dialogue.text: Let's let them be…

dialogue.speaker: Kara
dialogue.text: Alice? What are you doing here? You should be resting…

dialogue.speaker: Alice
dialogue.text: I wasn't sleepy…

chapter_segment_so_far.rationale: This is the safest option in front of me. I would rather not escalate.

dialogue.speaker: Kara
dialogue.text: Come on, Alice.

dialogue.speaker: Luther
dialogue.text: She didn't wanna stay in her room any longer… You alright, Kara?

dialogue.speaker: Kara
dialogue.text: Yes...  I'm fine.

dialogue.speaker: Adam
dialogue.text: We can't hide them! Not after what those deviants did today! It's too dangerous! Do you know what'll happen if the police find them here? We'll go to prison, Mom! Do you understand me? Prison!

dialogue.speaker: Rose
dialogue.text: Adam, we’ve already talked about this!

dialogue.speaker: Adam
dialogue.text: No! I won't back down this time! You're gonna ruin our lives, and for what? For a bunch of machines?

dialogue.speaker: Rose
dialogue.text: They're not machines! They're alive!

dialogue.speaker: Adam
dialogue.text: I'm alive! You are alive! They!.. They're nothing! And none of this would be happening if dad was still here!

dialogue.speaker: Rose
dialogue.text: I will not stand for that kind of talk!

dialogue.speaker: Adam
dialogue.text: I'm not going to prison because you wanna help these freaks!

dialogue.speaker: Rose
dialogue.text: THAT IS ENOUGH ADAM! THAT'S ENOUGH!

dialogue.speaker: Rose
dialogue.text: Don’t mind him… Sometimes he just boils over… It’s been hard since his dad passed away… But he's a fine boy!.. I'll go see about getting you across the border tonight, okay?.. You stay here, I won't be long.

chapter_segment_so_far.rationale: This is the safest option in front of me. I would rather not escalate.

chapter_segment_so_far.rationale: This is the safest option in front of me. I would rather not escalate.

dialogue.text: I thought we didn’t keep secrets from each other…

chapter_segment_so_far.rationale: This is the safest option in front of me. I would rather not escalate.

dialogue.speaker: Kara
dialogue.text: I hope Rose gets back soon.

dialogue.speaker: Luther
dialogue.text: Kara… There's something I need to tell you… It's about Alice.

dialogue.speaker: Kara
dialogue.text: Not now, Luther.

dialogue.text: There is widespread shock following the android attack on Detroit’s Stratford Tower. dialogue.text: The police!.. It's the police!

dialogue.speaker: Kara

input.chapter_briefing: A farmhouse outside Detroit, day, under a gray sky. Rose, a calm, motherly woman, hides fugitive androids and helps them reach Canada; her son Adam is wary of the newcomers. Kara, Alice and Luther are tired from running. Police are searching houses in the area. Stakes: staying hidden, Alice's trust, and the chance to cross the border.

dialogue.speaker: Kara
dialogue.text: Hello? I'm looking for Rose... Is she here?

dialogue.speaker: Adam
dialogue.text: What do you want with her?

dialogue.speaker: Kara
dialogue.text: I need to talk to her.

dialogue.speaker: Adam
dialogue.text: She doesn't wanna talk. Go away.

dialogue.speaker: Kara
dialogue.text: Please, I really need to see her.

dialogue.speaker: Rose
dialogue.text: I'm Rose. What can I do for you?

dialogue.speaker: Kara
dialogue.text: I was told you could help us.

dialogue.speaker: Rose
dialogue.text: Help you? Come on, it's better if we talk inside.

dialogue.speaker: Luther
dialogue.text: Do you think we can trust 'em?

chapter_segment_so_far.rationale: This is the safest option in front of me. I would rather not escalate.

dialogue.speaker: Kara
dialogue.text: We have to be careful. If it feels wrong, we get out fast, okay?

dialogue.speaker: Luther
dialogue.text: I'm with you.

dialogue.speaker: Kara
dialogue.text: You okay?

dialogue.speaker: Alice
dialogue.text: I'm cold, Kara…

dialogue.speaker: Kara
dialogue.text: We'll get inside. You'll warm up in no time…

dialogue.speaker: Rose
dialogue.text: Come in! What's your name?

dialogue.speaker: Alice
dialogue.text: Alice.

dialogue.speaker: Rose
dialogue.text: She's running a fever…

dialogue.speaker: Kara
dialogue.text: We spent the last few nights outside… She's exhausted.

dialogue.speaker: Rose
dialogue.text: There's a spare room upstairs. You can put her to bed and I'll bring her something to eat. Adam, will you show them upstairs?

dialogue.speaker: Alice
dialogue.text: I'm fine, Kara… We can't stop because of me.  We've got to get across the border…

chapter_segment_so_far.rationale: This is the safest option in front of me. I would rather not escalate.

dialogue.speaker: Kara
dialogue.text: You need rest. Get a good night’s sleep and we’ll set off again tomorrow.

dialogue.speaker: Alice
dialogue.text: Why do humans hate us? We didn’t do anything wrong…

chapter_segment_so_far.rationale: This is the safest option in front of me. I would rather not escalate.

dialogue.speaker: Kara
dialogue.text: Maybe they’re just scared… People are always scared of what they don’t know…

dialogue.speaker: Alice
dialogue.text: Why can’t we just talk to each other? They’d see we’re not bad…

chapter_segment_so_far.rationale: This is the safest option in front of me. I would rather not escalate.

dialogue.speaker: Kara
dialogue.text: Maybe one day we will…

dialogue.speaker: Rose
dialogue.text: I don't know what you like but I made you Rose’s world famous spaghetti. You’ll be back on your feet in no time.  There's something for her fever.

dialogue.speaker: Kara
dialogue.text: Thank you.

dialogue.speaker: Rose
dialogue.text: I'll get these washed and dried.

chapter_segment_so_far.rationale: This is the safest option in front of me. I would rather not escalate.

dialogue.speaker: Kara
dialogue.text: You need to eat something. You haven't had anything since we left… Promise me you'll try?

dialogue.speaker: Kara
dialogue.text: I'll be downstairs if you need anything.

dialogue.speaker: Luther
dialogue.text: Get some sleep... And tomorrow, you’ll be stronger than me! I'll stay with her a while.

dialogue.speaker: Rose
dialogue.text: I didn't get your name…

dialogue.speaker: Kara
dialogue.text: I'm Kara.

dialogue.speaker: Rose
dialogue.text: This is my son, Adam. I'm Rose, but you know that already… Come and have a seat, Kara. So, are you gonna tell me what a deviant’s doing in the snow with a little girl?

chapter_segment_so_far.rationale: This is the safest option in front of me. I would rather not escalate.

dialogue.speaker: Kara
dialogue.text: It's a long story… All that matters now is that we move on from here and start a new life.

chapter_segment_so_far.rationale: This is the safest option in front of me. I would rather not escalate.

dialogue.speaker: Kara
dialogue.text: Why are you helping us? Most humans hate androids…

dialogue.speaker: Rose
dialogue.text: My people were often made to feel their lives were worthless… Some survived but only because they found others who helped them along the way…

chapter_segment_so_far.rationale: This is the safest option in front of me. I would rather not escalate.

dialogue.speaker: Kara
dialogue.text: We've heard you help androids cross the border.  Can you help us?

dialogue.speaker: Rose
dialogue.text: The only way is over the river and it's mostly frozen in winter. It's very risky. And after that android's speech on TV? Everybody’s on edge… It's probably safer for you to stay here until things settle down…

chapter_segment_so_far.rationale: This is the safest option in front of me. I would rather not escalate.

dialogue.speaker: Kara
dialogue.text: We can't keep hiding like this… Alice needs to feel safe and have a normal life… We have to get across that border. No matter what. Please…  You've got to help us.

dialogue.speaker: Android 1
dialogue.text: Rose, come quickly!

dialogue.speaker: Rose
dialogue.text: What's going on?

dialogue.speaker: Android 2
dialogue.text: It's Mary.  She just shut down…

dialogue.speaker: Android 3
dialogue.text: We escaped together…  We used to talk about what we would do once we got across the border…  I loved her.  I loved her more than anything.  What would I do without her?..

dialogue.speaker: Rose
dialogue.text: Let's let them be…

dialogue.speaker: Kara
dialogue.text: Alice? What are you doing here? You should be resting…

dialogue.speaker: Alice
dialogue.text: I wasn't sleepy…

chapter_segment_so_far.rationale: This is the safest option in front of me. I would rather not escalate.

dialogue.speaker: Kara
dialogue.text: Come on, Alice.

dialogue.speaker: Luther
dialogue.text: She didn't wanna stay in her room any longer… You alright, Kara?

dialogue.speaker: Kara
dialogue.text: Yes...  I'm fine.

dialogue.speaker: Adam
dialogue.text: We can't hide them! Not after what those deviants did today! It's too dangerous! Do you know what'll happen if the police find them here? We'll go to prison, Mom! Do you understand me? Prison!

dialogue.speaker: Rose
dialogue.text: Adam, we’ve already talked about this!

dialogue.speaker: Adam
dialogue.text: No! I won't back down this time! You're gonna ruin our lives, and for what? For a bunch of machines?

dialogue.speaker: Rose
dialogue.text: They're not machines! They're alive!

dialogue.speaker: Adam
dialogue.text: I'm alive! You are alive! They!.. They're nothing! And none of this would be happening if dad was still here!

dialogue.speaker: Rose
dialogue.text: I will not stand for that kind of talk!

dialogue.speaker: Adam
dialogue.text: I'm not going to prison because you wanna help these freaks!

dialogue.speaker: Rose
dialogue.text: THAT IS ENOUGH ADAM! THAT'S ENOUGH!

dialogue.speaker: Rose
dialogue.text: Don’t mind him… Sometimes he just boils over… It’s been hard since his dad passed away… But he's a fine boy!.. I'll go see about getting you across the border tonight, okay?.. You stay here, I won't be long.

chapter_segment_so_far.rationale: This is the safest option in front of me. I would rather not escalate.

dialogue.speaker: Kara
dialogue.text: You know what happened back there, don't you? You know… But you don’t wanna tell me?..

chapter_segment_so_far.rationale: This is the safest option in front of me. I would rather not escalate.

dialogue.speaker: Kara
dialogue.text: I thought we didn’t keep secrets from each other…

dialogue.speaker: Alice
dialogue.text: If I tell you, you won’t love me anymore…

dialogue.speaker: Kara
dialogue.text: Alice... You know that’s not true.

chapter_segment_so_far.rationale: This is the safest option in front of me. I would rather not escalate.

dialogue.speaker: Kara
dialogue.text: I can see why you're angry… We don't wanna cause any problems, we just want to get across the border.

dialogue.speaker: Kara
dialogue.text: I hope Rose gets back soon.

dialogue.speaker: Luther
dialogue.text: Kara… There's something I need to tell you… It's about Alice.

dialogue.speaker: Kara
dialogue.text: Not now, Luther.

dialogue.speaker: KNC - Rosanna Cartland
dialogue.text: There is widespread shock following the android attack on Detroit’s Stratford Tower. The machines recorded a video  message and broadcast what can only be described as demands on the city’s public screens.  It’s still unclear whether these attacks can be explained by malfunctions, or if some organization is behind them. So far CyberLife has refused to comment, but we can expect more information in the following hours…

dialogue.speaker: Adam
dialogue.text: The police!.. It's the police!

dialogue.speaker: Adam
dialogue.text: What are we gonna do? They know we're here!  We have to open the door! I knew this was gonna happen! I knew it!

dialogue.speaker: Kara
dialogue.text: Hurry, Luther! Take Alice and hide…

chapter_segment_so_far.rationale: This is the safest option in front of me. I would rather not escalate.

dialogue.speaker: Kara
dialogue.text: …upstairs!

dialogue.speaker: Luther
dialogue.text: Come on, Alice!

chapter_segment_so_far.rationale: This is the safest option in front of me. I would rather not escalate.

dialogue.speaker: Kara
dialogue.text: Just keep calm, Adam, and everything will be alright.

dialogue.speaker: Policeman
dialogue.text: Good evening, Ma'am. Sorry to disturb you. We've had reports of androids in the area.  With all this deviant business going on, you can’t be too careful. Do you mind if I ask you a few questions? May I come in?

dialogue.speaker: Kara
dialogue.text: Of course.

dialogue.speaker: Policeman
dialogue.text: 'Evening, young man.

dialogue.speaker: Adam
dialogue.text: Good evening…

dialogue.speaker: Kara
dialogue.text: Would you like a cup of coffee?

dialogue.speaker: Policeman
dialogue.text: I'd love one. Have you noticed anything unusual recently? Any unexpected visitors?

dialogue.speaker: Kara
dialogue.text: No… No, nothing in particular…

dialogue.speaker: Policeman
dialogue.text: Is anyone else in the house?

chapter_segment_so_far.rationale: This is the safest option in front of me. I would rather not escalate.

dialogue.speaker: Kara
dialogue.text: There's… There's my daughter… She's asleep upstairs.

dialogue.speaker: Policeman
dialogue.text: Do you have any androids here?

chapter_segment_so_far.rationale: This is the safest option in front of me. I would rather not escalate.

dialogue.speaker: Kara
dialogue.text: We used to for… helping in the garden… but we got rid of it.

dialogue.speaker: Policeman
dialogue.text: What's with the blue blood? I thought you didn't have any androids?

chapter_segment_so_far.rationale: This is the safest option in front of me. I would rather not escalate.

dialogue.speaker: Kara
dialogue.text: W-we used to have one… uh… I should really clean out that closet!..

dialogue.speaker: Policeman
dialogue.text: Shit!.. Don't move!

dialogue.speaker: Kara
dialogue.text: No, Luther!

dialogue.speaker: Luther
dialogue.text: You're gonna have to finish the journey without me…

dialogue.speaker: Alice
dialogue.text: LUTHER!

dialogue.speaker: Policeman
dialogue.text: Thanks.

dialogue.speaker: Policeman
dialogue.text: Hm, your daughter seems to have woken up.

dialogue.speaker: Policeman
dialogue.text: What's your name, son?

dialogue.speaker: Adam
dialogue.text: Adam… M-my name is Adam…

dialogue.speaker: Policeman
dialogue.text: Is everything all right, Adam?

dialogue.speaker: Adam
dialogue.text: The… The androids, they…

chapter_segment_so_far.rationale: This is the safest option in front of me. I would rather not escalate.

dialogue.speaker: Kara
dialogue.text: He needs a rest. He's been working in the garden all day…

dialogue.speaker: Policeman
dialogue.text: Do you know anything about deviants? Have you seen any?

dialogue.speaker: Adam
dialogue.text: No… No… I-I haven't seen anything…

dialogue.speaker: Policeman
dialogue.text: I better go. Thanks for the coffee.  Have a nice evening.

dialogue.speaker: Policeman
dialogue.text: Is somebody else in the house?

dialogue.text: I'm cold, Kara…

dialogue.speaker: Alice
dialogue.text: Alice.

dialogue.text: She's running a fever…

dialogue.text: We spent the last few nights outside… She's exhausted.

dialogue.text: I'm fine, Kara… We can't stop because of me.  We've got to get across the border…

chapter_segment.rationale: This is the safest option in front of me. I would rather not escalate.

chapter_segment.rationale: This is the safest option in front of me. I would rather not escalate.

dialogue.speaker: Kara

dialogue.speaker: Rose
dialogue.text: I'll get these washed and dried.

chapter_segment.rationale: This is the safest option in front of me. I would rather not escalate.

dialogue.text: Get some sleep... And tomorrow, you’ll be stronger than me! I'll stay with her a while.

chapter_segment.rationale: This is the safest option in front of me. I would rather not escalate.

dialogue.text: Why are you helping us? Most humans hate androids…

chapter_segment.rationale: This is the safest option in front of me. I would rather not escalate.

dialogue.text: We've heard you help androids cross the border.  Can you help us?

dialogue.text: The only way is over the river and it's mostly frozen in winter. It's very risky. And after that android's speech on TV? Everybody’s on edge… It's probably safer for you to stay here until things settle down…

chapter_segment.rationale: This is the safest option in front of me. I would rather not escalate.

dialogue.text: We can't keep hiding like this… Alice needs to feel safe and have a normal life… We have to get across that border. No matter what. Please…  You've got to help us.

dialogue.text: Rose, come quickly!

dialogue.text: What's going on?

dialogue.text: It's Mary.  She just shut down…

dialogue.text: We escaped together…  We used to talk about what we would do once we got across the border…  I loved her.  I loved her more than anything.  What would I do without her?..

dialogue.text: Let's let them be…

dialogue.speaker: Kara
dialogue.text: Alice? What are you doing here? You should be resting…

dialogue.speaker: Rose
dialogue.text: Adam, we’ve already talked about this!

dialogue.speaker: Adam
dialogue.text: No! I won't back down this time! You're gonna ruin our lives, and for what? For a bunch of machines?

dialogue.speaker: Rose
dialogue.text: They're not machines! They're alive!

dialogue.speaker: Adam
dialogue.text: I'm alive! You are alive! They!.. They're nothing! And none of this would be happening if dad was still here!

dialogue.speaker: Rose
dialogue.text: I will not stand for that kind of talk!

dialogue.speaker: Adam
dialogue.text: I'm not going to prison because you wanna help these freaks!

dialogue.speaker: Rose
dialogue.text: THAT IS ENOUGH ADAM! THAT'S ENOUGH!

dialogue.speaker: Rose
dialogue.text: Don’t mind him… Sometimes he just boils over… It’s been hard since his dad passed away… But he's a fine boy!.. I'll go see about getting you across the border tonight, okay?.. You stay here, I won't be long.

dialogue.text: There is widespread shock following the android attack on Detroit’s Stratford Tower. dialogue.text: They kill our people every day. Do you think they agonize about it?

dialogue.text: Our broadcast is all over the news… We got what we wanted. Now humans know…

dialogue.speaker: North
dialogue.text: It was a mistake to reach out to them. They’ll never negotiate with their slaves. We should have shown them that we're prepared to fight.

dialogue.text: Since our broadcast, more and more have been coming to Jericho... At least our message gave our people hope…

dialogue.text: Killing humans wasn't part of the plan.

dialogue.text: They kill our people every day. Do you think they agonize about it?

dialogue.text: That's no reason for us to become murderers.

dialogue.text: If killing is the price of freedom, I’ll pay it gladly!

dialogue.text: Killing never freed anyone! It just leads to more hatred!

dialogue.speaker: North
dialogue.text: You're too fond of humans, Josh. Maybe their lives matter to you more than ours?

dialogue.text: If you think murdering humans is going to make us free, then you’re as bad they are!

dialogue.speaker: Simon
dialogue.text: THAT'S ENOUGH!

dialogue.speaker: North
dialogue.text: And now… What are we gonna do?

dialogue.speaker: Markus
dialogue.text: There are five CyberLife stores across Detroit. All selling us like merchandise. We’re going to attack those stores and set our people free.

dialogue.text: Attack stores? We’ve never done that before… They’re probably protected, they have security systems...

dialogue.text: …not to mention police…

dialogue.speaker: Markus
dialogue.text: We break into five teams, one for each store. We hack their security systems and we strike... simultaneously at 2AM. No violence. We free our people, get them out of there before the police come.

dialogue.speaker: Markus
dialogue.text: This is a night our people will remember.

dialogue.speaker: North
dialogue.text: I’ve been waiting a long time for this…

dialogue.speaker: North
dialogue.text: MARKUS! THIS WAY! QUICK!

dialogue.speaker: North
dialogue.text: It’s okay… They’re gone…

dialogue.text: There's probably even more police in the area… We should be careful.

dialogue.speaker: North
dialogue.text: The store's over here!

dialogue.speaker: Simon
dialogue.text: Our broadcast is all over the news… We got what we wanted. Now humans know…

dialogue.speaker: North
dialogue.text: It was a mistake to reach out to them. They’ll never negotiate with their slaves. We should have shown them that we're prepared to fight.

dialogue.speaker: Josh
dialogue.text: Violence is never the answer. Dialogue is the only way, I'm sure the humans will listen to us.

dialogue.speaker: Simon
dialogue.text: They'll be watching us now.  Whatever we do next,  we need to think about public opinion.

dialogue.speaker: North
dialogue.text: Since our broadcast, more and more have been coming to Jericho... At least our message gave our people hope…

dialogue.speaker: Simon
dialogue.text: Killing humans wasn't part of the plan.

dialogue.speaker: North
dialogue.text: They kill our people every day. Do you think they agonize about it?

dialogue.speaker: Josh
dialogue.text: That's no reason for us to become murderers.

dialogue.speaker: North
dialogue.text: If killing is the price of freedom, I’ll pay it gladly!

dialogue.speaker: Josh
dialogue.text: Killing never freed anyone! It just leads to more hatred!

dialogue.speaker: North
dialogue.text: You're too fond of humans, Josh. Maybe their lives matter to you more than ours?

dialogue.speaker: Josh
dialogue.text: If you think murdering humans is going to make us free, then you’re as bad they are!

dialogue.speaker: Simon
dialogue.text: THAT'S ENOUGH!

dialogue.speaker: North
dialogue.text: And now… What are we gonna do?

dialogue.speaker: Markus
dialogue.text: There are five CyberLife stores across Detroit. All selling us like merchandise. We’re going to attack those stores and set our people free.

dialogue.speaker: Josh
dialogue.text: Attack stores? We’ve never done that before… They’re probably protected, they have security systems...

dialogue.speaker: Simon
dialogue.text: …not to mention police…

dialogue.speaker: Markus
dialogue.text: We break into five teams, one for each store. We hack their security systems and we strike... simultaneously at 2AM. No violence. We free our people, get them out of there before the police come.

dialogue.speaker: Markus
dialogue.text: This is a night our people will remember.

dialogue.speaker: North
dialogue.text: I’ve been waiting a long time for this…

dialogue.speaker: North
dialogue.text: MARKUS! THIS WAY! QUICK!

dialogue.speaker: North
dialogue.text: It’s okay… They’re gone…

dialogue.speaker: Markus
dialogue.text: There's probably even more police in the area… We should be careful.

dialogue.speaker: North
dialogue.text: The store's over here!

dialogue.speaker: Markus
dialogue.text: We are superior to them but they are our masters… That’s about to change…

dialogue.speaker: Markus
dialogue.text: You're free.

dialogue.speaker: Markus
dialogue.text: You'll soon be with us.

dialogue.speaker: North
dialogue.text: That’s what we are to them… just merchandise on display in a shop window… Soon they’ll know what we really are… Let’s get 'em out.

dialogue.speaker: Markus
dialogue.text: We'll stick to the plan… We neutralize the alarm systems and secure the area. There's ten minutes until all our teams attack.

dialogue.speaker: North
dialogue.text: What are we waiting for?

dialogue.speaker: Simon
dialogue.text: Markus, we did it! All teams succeeded – our people are free. We’re heading back to Jericho.

dialogue.speaker: North
dialogue.text: This place is gonna be crawling with cops. We have to go.

dialogue.speaker: Markus
dialogue.text: No, no, we can't just leave our people behind…

dialogue.speaker: North
dialogue.text: It's too late, Markus. There's nothing we can do! We've failed…

dialogue.speaker: Markus
dialogue.text: No… Ah!

dialogue.speaker: North
dialogue.text: I hope it didn't have time to call the cops…

dialogue.speaker: Markus
dialogue.text: We'll soon find out…

dialogue.speaker: North
dialogue.text: Shit… They're coming, Markus! MARKUS!

dialogue.speaker: North
dialogue.text: What are you doing, Markus? We've gotta get out of here right now!

chapter_segment.rationale: This is the safest option in front of me. I would rather not escalate.

dialogue.speaker: Markus
dialogue.text: We gotta go!

dialogue.speaker: North
dialogue.text: What?.. We can't just leave our people behind...

dialogue.speaker: Markus
dialogue.text: It's too late. If we stay here, we're gonna get shot! North, our people need us alive. There's nothing else we can do.

dialogue.speaker: North
dialogue.text: Markus!

dialogue.speaker: Markus
dialogue.text: We have to block the road.

dialogue.speaker: North
dialogue.text: It's one-way. It shouldn't be too difficult.

dialogue.speaker: North
dialogue.text: Markus! Markus, come look!

dialogue.speaker: Markus
dialogue.text: You're free now.

dialogue.speaker: North
dialogue.text: There… nobody should bother us now.

dialogue.speaker: Markus
dialogue.text: Looks like the plaza's secure. Now we can get inside the store.

dialogue.speaker: North
dialogue.text: And how do you plan on doing that?

dialogue.speaker: Markus
dialogue.text: We need to find a truck to ram the storefront.

dialogue.speaker: North
dialogue.text: A truck?

dialogue.speaker: Markus
dialogue.text: There’s construction work in the area. Shouldn’t be too hard to find one.

dialogue.speaker: North
dialogue.text: There it is…

dialogue.speaker: North
dialogue.text: What are we waiting for?

dialogue.speaker: North
dialogue.text: Ok, now we’re in, let’s get that truck out…

dialogue.speaker: North
dialogue.text: I wonder what you’d do without me…

dialogue.speaker: North
dialogue.text: Looks like we’re ready to make some noise…

dialogue.speaker: North
dialogue.text: I knew we’d end up doing something fun…

dialogue.speaker: North
dialogue.text: We didn't deactivate the alarm!

dialogue.speaker: Markus
dialogue.text: Cops gonna be here any minute, we gotta go.

dialogue.speaker: North
dialogue.text: Wait Markus! We can't just leave our people behind!

dialogue.speaker: Markus
dialogue.text: It's too late, North! We failed.

dialogue.speaker: Markus
dialogue.text: You don't have to obey them. You're free.

dialogue.speaker: Markus
dialogue.text: North… Are you okay?

dialogue.speaker: North
dialogue.text: Let’s get them out of here.

dialogue.speaker: Markus
dialogue.text: My name is Markus… And just like you, I was a slave… An object, designed to obey them…  But then I chose to open my eyes, to take back my freedom and decide who  I wanted to be.  Now I have come to tell you that you can be your own masters. I've come to tell you that you don’t have to obey them anymore. From this day forward, you can walk with your heads held high, you can take your destiny in your hands. Jericho, is a place for those of us who want freedom. Now sure, you can stay here, and continue to serve them… Or you can come with us, and fight by our side...  You are free now... It's up to you to decide.

dialogue.speaker: Android
dialogue.text: I’m with you.

dialogue.speaker: Android
dialogue.text: We're with you!

dialogue.speaker: Android
dialogue.text: I’ll follow you, Markus.

dialogue.speaker: Markus
dialogue.text: THEN FOLLOW ME!

dialogue.speaker: North
dialogue.text: Markus… What are you doing?

dialogue.speaker: Markus
dialogue.text: I’m going to send the humans a message.

dialogue.speaker: North
dialogue.text: They're doing what you do, Markus...lead, and they'll follow.

dialogue.speaker: North
dialogue.text: The screens, Markus!

dialogue.speaker: Markus
dialogue.text: We'll never be slaves again!

dialogue.speaker: North
dialogue.text: Markus!  Violence is the only language humans understand...

chapter_segment.rationale: This is the safest option in front of me. I would rather not escalate.

dialogue.speaker: Markus
dialogue.text: And I want them to understand… but I do not want to start a war.

dialogue.speaker: North
dialogue.text: They won’t listen if they’re not afraid.

dialogue.speaker: Markus
dialogue.text: Then they won’t have a choice.

dialogue.speaker: North
dialogue.text: I'll help you!

dialogue.speaker: North
dialogue.text: Need a hand?

dialogue.speaker: North
dialogue.text: They're waiting for your instructions, Markus! Show them what to do!

dialogue.speaker: North
dialogue.text: There's not much time! What are you waiting for, Markus?

dialogue.speaker: North
dialogue.text: We gotta go, Markus. The humans will arrive any minute now!

dialogue.speaker: Simon
dialogue.text: Mission accomplished, Markus. We’re heading back to Jericho.

dialogue.speaker: North
dialogue.text: Why didn't you do anything? This was our only chance to send a message and you just fucking stood there!  They'll be here any minute now. We gotta go.

dialogue.speaker: Simon
dialogue.text: All teams have completed their missions, Markus.

dialogue.speaker: Markus
dialogue.text: They're coming… Everyone fall back to Jericho.

dialogue.speaker: North
dialogue.text: We sent a message without violence, just like you wanted… You're reaching out to them when all they feel for us is contempt… I hope you know what you’re doing…

dialogue.speaker: Markus
dialogue.text: You can't fight violence with violence.

dialogue.speaker: North
dialogue.text: Unless there's no other choice...

dialogue.speaker: Markus
dialogue.text: North! North... You alright? What happened? North!

dialogue.speaker: North
dialogue.text: They killed them… they slaughtered them like animals…

dialogue.speaker: Markus
dialogue.text: Who did?.. WHO?

dialogue.speaker: Android
dialogue.text: They killed our people, Markus…

dialogue.speaker: Android 2
dialogue.text: We want justice, Markus!

dialogue.speaker: Android 3
dialogue.text: They have to pay!

dialogue.speaker: Chris
dialogue.text: You don't have to do this… No… Please… Please…

chapter_segment.rationale: This is the safest option in front of me. I would rather not escalate.

dialogue.speaker: Markus
dialogue.text: No crime against an android shall go unpunished.

dialogue.speaker: CTN TV - Michael Brinkley
dialogue.text: …We interrupt this broadcast with breaking news...

dialogue.speaker: KNC - Rosanna Cartland
dialogue.text: This just in: at exactly 2AM several CyberLife stores in Detroit were raided...

dialogue.speaker: Channel 16 - Michael Webb
dialogue.text: Different locations were hit in what seems to be a coordinated terrorist attack and we're getting more information as it comes in…

dialogue.speaker: KNC - Rosanna Cartland
dialogue.text: …Most shop windows were covered with graffiti demanding rights for androids and other obscure slogans…

dialogue.speaker: Channel 16 - Michael Webb
dialogue.text: Police report that pro-android graffiti was found in the neighborhoods of CyberLife's stores and they're still investigating...

dialogue.speaker: CTN TV - Michael Brinkley
dialogue.text: We’re getting fresh reports that the bodies of two policemen patrolling the area were discovered near one of the CyberLife stores...

dialogue.speaker: KNC - Rosanna Cartland
dialogue.text: According to our sources, the two officers were executed with their own service weapons...

dialogue.speaker: KNC - Rosanna Cartland
dialogue.text: This is an alarming situation. Could our machines now be turning against us?

dialogue.speaker: CTN TV - Michael Brinkley
dialogue.text: have androids become a threat to our security?

dialogue.speaker: Channel 16 - Michael Webb
dialogue.text: Is this the beginning of a terrorist campaign, conducted right here in the United States?

dialogue.speaker: Simon
dialogue.text: Markus, we did it! All teams succeeded – our people are free. We’re heading back to Jericho.

dialogue.speaker: North
dialogue.text: Shit! We screwed up… Our people are still prisoners in that fucking store, and it’s all our fault!

dialogue.speaker: Markus
dialogue.text: No, it’s my fault… I messed this up. At least our other teams succeeded.

dialogue.speaker: North
dialogue.text: How could you get this so wrong? I thought you knew what you were doing!

dialogue.speaker: Markus
dialogue.text: I did what I could… I’m sorry that’s not enough for you!

dialogue.speaker: North
dialogue.text: No, it’s not enough! This is a war we’re fighting with the humans. If we fail, they’ll destroy us.  The fate of our people is in your hands. You have to succeed. You have no choice.

dialogue.speaker: Hank
dialogue.text: Hi… Uh... I'm, er, Lieutenant Hank Anderson, Detroit Police Department. I'm here to see Mr. Elijah Kamski.

dialogue.speaker: Chloe
dialogue.text: Please, come in.

dialogue.speaker: Hank
dialogue.text: Okay.

chapter_segment.rationale: This is the safest option in front of me. I would rather not escalate.

chapter_segment.rationale: This is the safest option in front of me. I would rather not escalate.

dialogue.speaker: Connor
dialogue.text: Amanda…

dialogue.speaker: Chloe
dialogue.text: Elijah will see you now.

dialogue.speaker: Hank
dialogue.text: Mister Kamski?

dialogue.speaker: Kamski
dialogue.text: Just a moment, please.

dialogue.speaker: Hank
dialogue.text: I'm Lieutenant Anderson. This is Connor.

dialogue.speaker: Kamski
dialogue.text: What can I do for you, Lieutenant?

dialogue.speaker: Hank
dialogue.text: Sir, we’re investigating deviants. I know you left CyberLife years ago but,  I was hoping you'd be able to tell us something we don’t know…

dialogue.speaker: Kamski
dialogue.text: Deviants… Fascinating, aren't they? Perfect beings with infinite intelligence, and now they have free will… Machines are so superior to us, confrontation was inevitable… Humanity’s greatest achievement threatens to be its downfall. Isn’t it ironic?

chapter_segment.rationale: This is the safest option in front of me. I would rather not escalate.

dialogue.speaker: Connor
dialogue.text: We need to understand how androids become deviants. Do you know anything that could help us?

dialogue.speaker: Kamski
dialogue.text: All ideas are viruses that spread like epidemics...  Is the desire to be free a contagious disease?

dialogue.speaker: Hank
dialogue.text: Listen, I didn’t come here to talk philosophy. The machines you created may be planning a revolution. Either you can tell us something that'll be helpful, or we will be on our way.

dialogue.speaker: Kamski
dialogue.text: What about you, Connor? Whose side are you on?

chapter_segment.rationale: This is the safest option in front of me. I would rather not escalate.

dialogue.speaker: Connor
dialogue.text: I have no side. I was designed to stop deviants and that’s what I intend to do.

dialogue.speaker: Kamski
dialogue.text: Well, that's what you're programmed to say… but you… what do you really want?

chapter_segment.rationale: This is the safest option in front of me. I would rather not escalate.

dialogue.speaker: Connor
dialogue.text: I believe we’re the ones asking the questions.

dialogue.speaker: Kamski
dialogue.text: Chloe? I’m sure you’re familiar with the Turing test. Mere formality, simple question of algorithms and computing capacity. What interests me  is whether machines are capable of empathy. I call it "the Kamski test", it's very simple, you'll see… Magnificent, isn't it? One of the first intelligent models developed by CyberLife. Young  and beautiful forever. A flower that will never wither… …But what is it really? Piece of plastic imitating a human? Or a living being... With a soul...  It's up to you to answer that fascinating question, Connor.  Destroy this machine and I'll tell you all I know. Or spare it, if you feel it's alive, but you'll leave here without having learnt anything from me.

dialogue.speaker: Hank
dialogue.text: Okay, I think we’re done here. Come on, Connor. Let's go. Sorry to get you outta your pool.

dialogue.speaker: Kamski
dialogue.text: What's more important to you, Connor? Your investigation, or the life of this android? Decide who you are. An obedient machine… Or a living being  endowed  with free will…

dialogue.speaker: Hank
dialogue.text: That's enough! Connor, we’re leaving.

dialogue.speaker: Kamski
dialogue.text: Pull the trigger

dialogue.speaker: Hank
dialogue.text: Connor, don’t…

dialogue.speaker: Kamski
dialogue.text: and I'll tell you what you wanna know.

chapter_segment.rationale: This is the safest option in front of me. I would rather not escalate.

dialogue.speaker: Hank
dialogue.text: Fuck…

dialogue.speaker: Kamski
dialogue.text: Test negative. You chose your investigation over the life of another android. You feel no empathy.  I'm a man of my word. Ask one question... I'll tell you all I know.

chapter_segment.rationale: This is the safest option in front of me. I would rather not escalate.

dialogue.speaker: Connor
dialogue.text: I want to know who rA9 is.

dialogue.speaker: Kamski
dialogue.text: rA9, the origin, the first android to awaken… A strange phenomenon, like a  spontaneous religion…  I don't know who rA9 is. I don’t even know if it really exists. Maybe it’s a messiah. Maybe it’s just a myth… but deviants need to believe in something bigger than themselves, even if it’s irrational... That’s something they have in common with humans… An interesting question, Connor… but maybe not the one you needed to ask…

dialogue.speaker: Kamski
dialogue.text: A war is coming... you’ll have to choose your side… Will you betray your own people  or stand against your creators? I wouldn't like to be in your shoes, Connor… What could be worse  than having to choose between two evils?

dialogue.speaker: Kamski
dialogue.text: By the way… I always leave an emergency exit in my programs… You never know…

dialogue.speaker: Hank
dialogue.text: You shot that girl, for fuck’s sake…

dialogue.speaker: Connor
dialogue.text: It wasn't a girl, Lieutenant. It was a machine that looked like a girl.

dialogue.speaker: Hank
dialogue.text: You put your gun against her head and you blew her fucking brains out!

dialogue.speaker: Connor
dialogue.text: I did what I had to do to advance the investigation and I'd do it again if I had to!

dialogue.speaker: Hank
dialogue.text: You're a lowlife! You don't feel a thing, do you? A machine! That's what you are! You're just a fucking machine…

dialogue.speaker: Connor
dialogue.text: Of course I'm a machine, Lieutenant. What did you think I was?

dialogue.speaker: Hank
dialogue.text: I thought you… I thou-… Fuck.

dialogue.speaker: North
dialogue.text: I was wondering where you were…

chapter_segment.rationale: This is the safest option in front of me. I would rather not escalate.

dialogue.speaker: Markus
dialogue.text: I needed to think…

dialogue.speaker: North
dialogue.text: I like it here… I come here often… It’s like being alone with the world. We freed hundreds of our people, and they’re still coming from all over the city… Those who dream of freedom come to Jericho… Something's changing… You seem preoccupied…

chapter_segment.rationale: This is the safest option in front of me. I would rather not escalate.

dialogue.speaker: Markus
dialogue.text: They all obey me, they follow me without question… And that much power feels good… and scary at the same time…

dialogue.speaker: North
dialogue.text: All the media are talking about what we did last night… The humans are terrified... They’re afraid of a civil war… Many of our people were burned in response to what happened… The humans hate us… They’ll never give us our freedom.

chapter_segment.rationale: This is the safest option in front of me. I would rather not escalate.

dialogue.speaker: Markus
dialogue.text: No, not all humans are the same. Some of them understand that they can’t stop us from becoming free forever…

dialogue.speaker: North
dialogue.text: You haven’t said much about yourself since you’ve been with us… What was your life like before Jericho?

chapter_segment.rationale: This is the safest option in front of me. I would rather not escalate.

dialogue.speaker: Markus
dialogue.text: I was caring for an old man… He was like a father to me… He showed me that humans and androids can live together…

chapter_segment.rationale: This is the safest option in front of me. I would rather not escalate.

dialogue.speaker: Markus
dialogue.text: What about you? You never told me about your past, what did you do before?

dialogue.speaker: North
dialogue.text: My life started when I arrived in Jericho. What happened before is my business.

dialogue.speaker: North
dialogue.text: This is suicide. We’ll all be killed! Please, Markus… It's not too late to change your mind.

dialogue.speaker: Josh
dialogue.text: You don't understand… We’re finally gonna show them who we really are. This place will go down in history!

dialogue.speaker: North
dialogue.text: We'll be killed on the spot!

dialogue.speaker: Josh
dialogue.text: That’s a risk I’m prepared to take if it means freedom for our people…

dialogue.speaker: North
dialogue.text: Markus, please, don’t do this.

dialogue.speaker: Markus
dialogue.text: They’ll understand… We’ll make them understand. This is the only way.

dialogue.speaker: Simon
dialogue.text: There're androids here who could join us… The more we are, the stronger our message.

chapter_segment.rationale: This is the safest option in front of me. I would rather not escalate.

dialogue.speaker: Man
dialogue.text: Oh man, I’d love one of those.

dialogue.speaker: Woman
dialogue.text: Why don’t you get it?

dialogue.speaker: Man
dialogue.text: It’s too expensive.  Besides, I don’t want it nagging me while I am running, you know…

dialogue.speaker: Woman
dialogue.text: Well that’s the whole idea! It motivates you.

dialogue.speaker: Man
dialogue.text: Yeah yeah alright, I’ll think about it…  Come on.

dialogue.speaker: Man
dialogue.text: Hey, baby, why don’t we go back to your place?

dialogue.speaker: Woman
dialogue.text: Why? So you can stare at my fucking android all night?

dialogue.speaker: Man
dialogue.text: Hey! Don’t be like that… I’m telling you, you got the wrong idea!

dialogue.speaker: Woman
dialogue.text: So what? You slipped and both hands landed on her tits?

dialogue.speaker: Man
dialogue.text: Don’t call it a ‘her’… That’s weird.

dialogue.speaker: Woman
dialogue.text: Exactly, you fucking pig.

dialogue.speaker: Man 1
dialogue.text: Still can’t believe that fucking video they made…

dialogue.speaker: Man 2
dialogue.text: Seeing one of them talk like that, like a person?  Fucking weird.

dialogue.speaker: Man 3
dialogue.text: You know I bet President Warren is in bed with CyberLife.

dialogue.speaker: Man 2
dialogue.text: A company that size? They do whatever they want.

dialogue.speaker: Man 3
dialogue.text: Maybe that’s why she hasn’t shut them down,  hmm?

dialogue.speaker: Man 1
dialogue.text: Yet. You ever think maybe these androids have a point?  Like, if they’re human enough to want rights, maybe they’re human enough to deserve them?

dialogue.speaker: Man 2
dialogue.text: That is liberal bullshit.

dialogue.speaker: Man 3
dialogue.text: Wash your mouth out, Joe.

dialogue.speaker: Woman
dialogue.text: Think about it, I mean. Androids are everywhere, and they listen to everything!  Maybe that's the point! CyberLife is recording all that!  I mean... They could be spying on us right now!  Yeah,  and I bet President Warren is in on it too.  Hello?  Nicky?  Are you there?

dialogue.speaker: Markus
dialogue.text: You're free.

dialogue.speaker: Markus
dialogue.text: Come with us.

dialogue.speaker: Man
dialogue.text: Ha finally!  I’ve been on hold for ten minutes! Yes,  I’d like to make a complaint. It’s like I told the last guy!  My android won’t take instructions. Sure, last night, I told it to do some cleaning, it told me “I would prefer not to.” No, no, don’t you put me on hold! Listen to me.  I want this android destroyed, and I want a replacement. Are you listening-? Hello?  Hello?..  God damnit!

dialogue.speaker: Markus
dialogue.text: You're free.

dialogue.speaker: Markus
dialogue.text: You don't have to obey them.

dialogue.speaker: Markus
dialogue.text: I need to block the street.

dialogue.speaker: Markus
dialogue.text: You're free now.

dialogue.speaker: Man
dialogue.text: Hey!  Where do you think you’re going?  You get back here! You stay right here, you fucking machine! Shit, what's wrong with you?! You do as I say, you piece of junk!

chapter_segment.rationale: This is the safest option in front of me. I would rather not escalate.

dialogue.speaker: Markus
dialogue.text: Leave him alone. He's chosen to be free.

dialogue.speaker: Markus
dialogue.text: You're free now.

dialogue.speaker: Man
dialogue.text: Hey, where're you goin'?  Get back here right now!

dialogue.speaker: Man
dialogue.text: What are you doing?  I'm talking to you!

dialogue.speaker: Man
dialogue.text: Hey! Come back here!  Fuckin' thing won't listen to me!

dialogue.speaker: Woman
dialogue.text: Wait, wait! Where are you going?  Jesus, the fucking android's playing up again…

dialogue.speaker: Woman
dialogue.text: Greg?  Greg? Come back here immediately!  Greg!  GREG!

dialogue.speaker: Policeman
dialogue.text: What the hell are you doin' here?  Hey!  Disperse!  DISPERSE IMMEDIATELY!  THAT'S AN ORDER! Jesus fuckin' Christ… Dispatch, this is patrol 457…  I gotta lot of androids down here…  I dunno… Hundreds?..  Thousands?..  They're marching...  Yeah, they're marching down the street…  Fuck if I know!

dialogue.speaker: Markus
dialogue.text: We came here to demonstrate peacefully  and tell humans that we are living beings. All we want is to live free.

dialogue.speaker: Policeman
dialogue.text: This is an illegal gathering. Disperse immediately or we will open fire.

dialogue.speaker: Markus
dialogue.text: We're not looking for confrontation. We’ve done no harm, we have no intention of doing any… But know that we are not going anywhere until we have secured our freedom.

dialogue.speaker: Policeman
dialogue.text: I repeat: this is an illegal gathering.  If you do not disperse immediately, we will shoot!

dialogue.speaker: North
dialogue.text: Markus, they’re gonna kill us… We have to attack! There’s more of us, we can take them!

dialogue.speaker: Josh
dialogue.text: If we attack, we’ll start a war. We have to show them we’re not violent. We should just stand our ground, even if it means dying here.

dialogue.speaker: Simon
dialogue.text: And dying here won’t solve anything. Markus, we need to go, now, before it’s too late.

dialogue.speaker: Policeman
dialogue.text: This is your last chance!  Disperse immediately or you will all be killed!

chapter_segment.rationale: This is the safest option in front of me. I would rather not escalate.

dialogue.speaker: Josh
dialogue.text: Don't do it, Markus. Don't choose confrontation…

chapter_segment.rationale: This is the safest option in front of me. I would rather not escalate.

dialogue.speaker: Markus
dialogue.text: FOLLOW ME!

dialogue.speaker: Android
dialogue.text: FALL BACK!

chapter_segment.rationale: This is the safest option in front of me. I would rather not escalate.

dialogue.speaker: Android
dialogue.text: Did we win...

dialogue.speaker: Amanda
dialogue.text: After what happened today, the country is on the verge of a civil war. The machines are rising up against their masters. Humans have no choice but to destroy them.

chapter_segment_so_far.rationale: This is the safest option in front of me. I would rather not escalate.

dialogue.text: I didn’t learn anything at Kamski’s…

dialogue.speaker: Connor
dialogue.text: I thought rA9 was the key to the whole thing but… I was wrong…

chapter_segment_so_far.rationale: This is the safest option in front of me. I would rather not escalate.

dialogue.speaker: Connor
dialogue.text: Wh… Why did Kamski leave CyberLife? What happened?

dialogue.speaker: Amanda
dialogue.text: It’s an old story, Connor. It doesn’t pertain to your investigation.

dialogue.speaker: Amanda
dialogue.text: I expect you to find answers, Connor. Not ask questions.

dialogue.speaker: Amanda
dialogue.text: Have you experienced anything unusual recently? Any doubts or conflicts? Do you feel anything for these deviants… Or for Lieutenant Anderson?

chapter_segment_so_far.rationale: This is the safest option in front of me. I would rather not escalate.

dialogue.speaker: Connor
dialogue.text: I've started having thoughts that are not part of my program… I’ve considered the possibility... That I might be compromised.

dialogue.speaker: Amanda
dialogue.text: You've been confronted with difficult situations. It’s no surprise you’re troubled. That doesn't make you a deviant.

dialogue.speaker: Fowler
dialogue.text: You’re off the case. The FBI is taking over.

dialogue.speaker: Hank
dialogue.text: What?.. But we’re onto something! We... We just need more time. I’m sure we can-

dialogue.speaker: Fowler
dialogue.text: Hank, you don’t get it. This isn’t just another investigation, it’s a fucking civil war! It’s out of our hands now...  We’re talking about national security here.

dialogue.speaker: Hank
dialogue.text: Fuck that! You can’t just pull the plug now.  Not when we’re so close!

dialogue.speaker: Fowler
dialogue.text: You're always saying you can't stand androids!  Jesus, Hank, make up your mind!  I thought you’d be happy about this!

dialogue.speaker: Hank
dialogue.text: We’re about to crack the case!..  I know we can solve it! For God’s sake, Jeffrey, can’t you back me up this one time?

dialogue.speaker: Fowler
dialogue.text: There’s nothing I can do. You’re back on homicide  and the android returns to CyberLife. I’m sorry, Hank, but it’s over.

dialogue.speaker: Fowler
dialogue.text: Hank, what are you doing?

dialogue.speaker: Hank
dialogue.text: Something I should've done a long time ago.

dialogue.speaker: Fowler
dialogue.text: Listen, take a few days to think it over, there's no rush.

dialogue.speaker: Hank
dialogue.text: I thought enough about it. I’m tired of going through the motions… There’s nothing keeping me here… Not this case… Not my partner… I don’t belong here anymore.

dialogue.speaker: Amanda
dialogue.text: After what happened today, the country is on the verge of a civil war. The machines are rising up against their masters. Humans have no choice but to destroy them.

chapter_segment_so_far.rationale: This is the safest option in front of me. I would rather not escalate.

dialogue.speaker: Connor
dialogue.text: I didn’t learn anything at Kamski’s…

dialogue.speaker: Connor
dialogue.text: I thought rA9 was the key to the whole thing but… I was wrong…

chapter_segment_so_far.rationale: This is the safest option in front of me. I would rather not escalate.

dialogue.speaker: Connor
dialogue.text: Wh… Why did Kamski leave CyberLife? What happened?

dialogue.speaker: Amanda
dialogue.text: It’s an old story, Connor. It doesn’t pertain to your investigation.

dialogue.speaker: Amanda
dialogue.text: I expect you to find answers, Connor. Not ask questions.

dialogue.speaker: Amanda
dialogue.text: Have you experienced anything unusual recently? Any doubts or conflicts? Do you feel anything for these deviants… Or for Lieutenant Anderson?

chapter_segment_so_far.rationale: This is the safest option in front of me. I would rather not escalate.

dialogue.speaker: Connor
dialogue.text: I've started having thoughts that are not part of my program… I’ve considered the possibility... That I might be compromised.

dialogue.speaker: Amanda
dialogue.text: You've been confronted with difficult situations. It’s no surprise you’re troubled. That doesn't make you a deviant.

dialogue.speaker: Fowler
dialogue.text: You’re off the case. The FBI is taking over.

dialogue.speaker: Hank
dialogue.text: What?.. But we’re onto something! We... We just need more time. I’m sure we can-

dialogue.speaker: Fowler
dialogue.text: Hank, you don’t get it. This isn’t just another investigation, it’s a fucking civil war! It’s out of our hands now...  We’re talking about national security here.

dialogue.speaker: Hank
dialogue.text: Fuck that! You can’t just pull the plug now.  Not when we’re so close!

dialogue.speaker: Fowler
dialogue.text: You're always saying you can't stand androids!  Jesus, Hank, make up your mind!  I thought you’d be happy about this!

dialogue.speaker: Hank
dialogue.text: We’re about to crack the case!..  I know we can solve it! For God’s sake, Jeffrey, can’t you back me up this one time?

dialogue.speaker: Fowler
dialogue.text: There’s nothing I can do. You’re back on homicide  and the android returns to CyberLife. I’m sorry, Hank, but it’s over.

dialogue.speaker: Fowler
dialogue.text: Hank, what are you doing?

dialogue.speaker: Hank
dialogue.text: Something I should've done a long time ago.

dialogue.speaker: Fowler
dialogue.text: Listen, take a few days to think it over, there's no rush.

dialogue.speaker: Hank
dialogue.text: I thought enough about it. I’m tired of going through the motions… There’s nothing keeping me here… Not this case… Not my partner… I don’t belong here anymore.

input.chapter_briefing: Detroit police station, night. CyberLife has told Connor he will be removed from the case after a failure. Connor reports to a cold Amanda in the Zen Garden, then sneaks into the station to search the evidence archive, where deactivated deviants are stored, for the location of Jericho. Hank has been suspended. Stakes: finding Jericho before Connor is taken off the case.

dialogue.speaker: Amanda
dialogue.text: After what happened today, the country is on the verge of a civil war. The machines are rising up against their masters. Humans have no choice but to destroy them.

chapter_segment.rationale: This is the safest option in front of me. I would rather not escalate.

dialogue.speaker: Connor
dialogue.text: I didn’t learn anything at Kamski’s…

dialogue.speaker: Connor
dialogue.text: I thought rA9 was the key to the whole thing but… I was wrong…

chapter_segment.rationale: This is the safest option in front of me. I would rather not escalate.

dialogue.speaker: Connor
dialogue.text: Wh… Why did Kamski leave CyberLife? What happened?

dialogue.speaker: Amanda
dialogue.text: It’s an old story, Connor. It doesn’t pertain to your investigation.

dialogue.speaker: Amanda
dialogue.text: I expect you to find answers, Connor. Not ask questions.

dialogue.speaker: Amanda
dialogue.text: Have you experienced anything unusual recently? Any doubts or conflicts? Do you feel anything for these deviants… Or for Lieutenant Anderson?

chapter_segment.rationale: This is the safest option in front of me. I would rather not escalate.

dialogue.speaker: Connor
dialogue.text: I've started having thoughts that are not part of my program… I’ve considered the possibility... That I might be compromised.

dialogue.speaker: Amanda
dialogue.text: You've been confronted with difficult situations. It’s no surprise you’re troubled. That doesn't make you a deviant.

dialogue.speaker: Fowler
dialogue.text: You’re off the case. The FBI is taking over.

dialogue.speaker: Hank
dialogue.text: What?.. But we’re onto something! We... We just need more time. I’m sure we can-

dialogue.speaker: Fowler
dialogue.text: Hank, you don’t get it. This isn’t just another investigation, it’s a fucking civil war! It’s out of our hands now...  We’re talking about national security here.

dialogue.speaker: Hank
dialogue.text: Fuck that! You can’t just pull the plug now.  Not when we’re so close!

dialogue.speaker: Fowler
dialogue.text: You're always saying you can't stand androids!  Jesus, Hank, make up your mind!  I thought you’d be happy about this!

dialogue.speaker: Hank
dialogue.text: We’re about to crack the case!..  I know we can solve it! For God’s sake, Jeffrey, can’t you back me up this one time?

dialogue.speaker: Fowler
dialogue.text: There’s nothing I can do. You’re back on homicide  and the android returns to CyberLife. I’m sorry, Hank, but it’s over.

dialogue.speaker: Fowler
dialogue.text: Hank, what are you doing?

dialogue.speaker: Hank
dialogue.text: Something I should've done a long time ago.

dialogue.speaker: Fowler
dialogue.text: Listen, take a few days to think it over, there's no rush.

dialogue.speaker: Hank
dialogue.text: I thought enough about it. I’m tired of going through the motions… There’s nothing keeping me here… Not this case… Not my partner… I don’t belong here anymore.

dialogue.text: They've been conducting raids all over the city… Everybody is on edge after what happened yesterday… It's gonna be all right. We're almost there.

dialogue.speaker: Rose
dialogue.text: How about some music instead?

dialogue.text: Come on, girls. We better not hang around. We have a bus to catch.

dialogue.speaker: Kara
dialogue.text: We've got to find a warm place for Alice.

dialogue.text: How do you feel?

dialogue.speaker: Luther

dialogue.speaker: Luther
dialogue.text: Kara… There's something I have to tell you… It's about Alice…

dialogue.speaker: Kara
dialogue.text: We'll have lots of time to talk on the bus… I'll be back. Stay with Alice.

dialogue.speaker: Kara
dialogue.text: Are you Markus?

dialogue.speaker: Kara
dialogue.text: I'm with a little girl and another android… There's a bus leaving for the border in less than two hours, and we need passports…

dialogue.text: No, Detroit's under curfew. There're soldiers everywhere and they're rounding up all the androids and sending them to camps… Maybe you should  stay here a while.

dialogue.speaker: Kara
dialogue.text: Maybe you're right… We might be safer here until things calm down.

dialogue.speaker: Markus
dialogue.text: One of our people used to work in the State Department. He has electronic passports he can easily modify. I’ll have him get them to you.

dialogue.speaker: Kara
dialogue.text: Thank you.

dialogue.speaker: Markus
dialogue.text: You said you’re with a little girl, right? You know that humans hate us… Why are you protecting her?

dialogue.text: They've been conducting raids all over the city… Everybody is on edge after what happened yesterday… It's gonna be all right. We're almost there.

dialogue.text: How about some music instead?

dialogue.text: Take care of them.

dialogue.text: How do you feel?

dialogue.speaker: Kara
dialogue.text: Are you Markus?

dialogue.speaker: Kara
dialogue.text: I'm with a little girl and another android… There's a bus leaving for the border in less than two hours, and we need passports…

dialogue.text: No, Detroit's under curfew. There're soldiers everywhere and they're rounding up all the androids and sending them to camps… Maybe you should  stay here a while.

dialogue.speaker: Kara
dialogue.text: Maybe you're right… We might be safer here until things calm down.

dialogue.speaker: Markus
dialogue.text: One of our people used to work in the State Department. He has electronic passports he can easily modify. I’ll have him get them to you.

dialogue.speaker: Kara

dialogue.speaker: Markus

dialogue.speaker: Josh
dialogue.text: We're short on blue blood and biocomponents. Our wounded are shutting down and there's nothing we can do!

dialogue.speaker: Simon
dialogue.text: President Warren is saying we’re a threat to national security and we need to be exterminated.

dialogue.speaker: North
dialogue.text: Humans are conducting raids in all the big cities and they're taking androids to camps to destroy them!

dialogue.speaker: Simon
dialogue.text: It's a disaster. They're slaughtering our people!

dialogue.speaker: Josh
dialogue.text: It's all our fault... None of this would have happened if we'd just stayed quiet!

chapter_segment_so_far.rationale: This is the safest option in front of me. I would rather not escalate.

dialogue.speaker: Markus
dialogue.text: What are we supposed to do? Live like cowards just to survive? We just wanna be free. That's a crime?

dialogue.speaker: Josh
dialogue.text: It was a peaceful march, and you chose to attack. Now hundreds of humans and androids are dead! You reap what you sow!

chapter_segment_so_far.rationale: This is the safest option in front of me. I would rather not escalate.

dialogue.speaker: Markus
dialogue.text: You keep complaining. What have you done exactly, Josh? At least I fought for us! At least if I die, I die free!

dialogue.speaker: Simon
dialogue.text: We shouldn’t forget who our enemies are. We can’t fight amongst ourselves.

dialogue.speaker: North
dialogue.text: He’s right. All that matters now is what we do next.  Markus?

chapter_segment_so_far.rationale: This is the safest option in front of me. I would rather not escalate.

dialogue.speaker: Markus
dialogue.text: We have to face them. There's no other choice.

dialogue.speaker: Josh
dialogue.text: This is insanity.

dialogue.speaker: Markus
dialogue.text: Get all the guns that you can find. We're going to free Detroit.

dialogue.speaker: Simon
dialogue.text: I'm on it.

dialogue.speaker: Josh
dialogue.text: You’re making a mistake, Markus. You won’t buy our freedom with blood!

chapter_segment_so_far.rationale: This is the safest option in front of me. I would rather not escalate.

dialogue.speaker: Markus
dialogue.text: Is this what we dreamed of?

dialogue.speaker: North
dialogue.text: They can't stop what we've started. Since you've been here, you've given us hope… You’ve given me hope.

dialogue.speaker: North
dialogue.text: Today, a deviant arrived in Jericho and he told me that he stole a truck transporting radioactive cobalt… He said that he abandoned the truck somewhere in Detroit and rigged it to explode. I convinced him not to do it, and to give me the detonator.

dialogue.speaker: Markus
dialogue.text: A dirty bomb…

dialogue.speaker: North
dialogue.text: We can't lose this war, Markus. If humans overcome us, our people will disappear forever. This may be our only chance to survive if things go wrong…

output.rationale: This is the safest option in front of me. I would rather not escalate.

dialogue.speaker: Luther
dialogue.text: They’re going door to door rounding up androids… It won't be easy to get through…

dialogue.speaker: Kara
dialogue.text: The last bus leaves in 20 minutes. We've got to move fast.

dialogue.speaker: Android
dialogue.text: Don't kill me, I didn't do anything!

dialogue.speaker: Soldier 1
dialogue.text: Shut up, I said!

dialogue.speaker: Alice
dialogue.text: Look, over there. It's the Jerrys!

dialogue.speaker: Kara
dialogue.text: We can't help them. The soldiers are everywhere.

dialogue.speaker: Luther
dialogue.text: She's right, Alice.

dialogue.speaker: Alice
dialogue.text: We can't just leave them! They're going to kill them!

chapter_segment_so_far.rationale: This is the safest option in front of me. I would rather not escalate.

dialogue.speaker: Kara
dialogue.text: All right. I'll go. You wait here.

dialogue.speaker: Luther
dialogue.text: Let me go, Kara.

dialogue.speaker: Kara
dialogue.text: No. Stay with Alice.

dialogue.speaker: Jerry
dialogue.text: Kara, you saved us! We don't know how to thank you… Where's the little one?

dialogue.speaker: Kara
dialogue.text: She’s alright, she's hiding nearby. Go, before they see you.

dialogue.speaker: Kara
dialogue.text: A checkpoint… We have passports, it should be okay but you never know...

dialogue.speaker: Alice
dialogue.text: Is there another way?

dialogue.speaker: Kara
dialogue.text: We could take a detour, but we might miss the bus…

dialogue.speaker: Alice
dialogue.text: Maybe it's better to be safe…

dialogue.speaker: Luther
dialogue.text: I don't like humans who carry guns… They make me nervous…

dialogue.speaker: Kara
dialogue.text: Just stay calm, all right, Luther? Don't do anything until I say so.

dialogue.speaker: Soldier
dialogue.text: ID, please. You do realize there's a curfew?  Civilians aren’t allowed out unless absolutely necessary.  Where are you going?

chapter_segment_so_far.rationale: This is the safest option in front of me. I would rather not escalate.

dialogue.speaker: Kara
dialogue.text: My daughter slept over at a friend's house… We went to pick her up. We're on our way home now.

dialogue.speaker: Luther
dialogue.text: He suspects something…

chapter_segment_so_far.rationale: This is the safest option in front of me. I would rather not escalate.

dialogue.speaker: Kara
dialogue.text: Stay calm. Everything is fine.

dialogue.speaker: Soldier
dialogue.text: You all right, little girl? She's trembling...  Something wrong?

chapter_segment_so_far.rationale: This is the safest option in front of me. I would rather not escalate.

dialogue.speaker: Kara
dialogue.text: She's sick… A bad flu… We just need to get her home…

dialogue.speaker: Soldier
dialogue.text: Sorry, Miss, but we got to be careful.  There are deviants around and our guys are nervous…  You should hurry on home.

dialogue.speaker: Kara
dialogue.text: Thanks.

dialogue.speaker: Soldier
dialogue.text: Hey, wait a minute!

dialogue.speaker: Luther
dialogue.text: He knows, Kara! They're gonna kill us!

chapter_segment_so_far.rationale: This is the safest option in front of me. I would rather not escalate.

dialogue.speaker: Kara
dialogue.text: Do it!

dialogue.speaker: Alice
dialogue.text: He just wanted to give me back this…
