dialogue.speaker: Kara
dialogue.text: The bus terminal… We've arrived, Alice… We made it…

chapter_segment_so_far.heading: Took too much time - Miss the bus

dialogue.speaker: Soldier
dialogue.text: The last bus has left the terminal. There will be no more buses until further notice.

chapter_segment_so_far.heading: Took too much time - Miss the bus

dialogue.speaker: Kara
dialogue.text: We missed it… We're stuck here… What are we going to do now?

chapter_segment_so_far.heading: Took too much time - Miss the bus

dialogue.speaker: Alice
dialogue.text: Kara…

chapter_segment_so_far.heading: Took too much time - Miss the bus

dialogue.speaker: Kara
dialogue.text: They're checking everyone… It won't take them long to find us. We need to get out of here…

dialogue.speaker: Kara
dialogue.text: The bus terminal… We've arrived, Alice… We made it…

dialogue.speaker: Soldier
dialogue.text: The last bus for the border is full. Ticket-holding passengers only. All departures are suspended until further notice.

dialogue.speaker: Kara
dialogue.text: We don't have tickets… They won't let us on… We're stuck here now… What are we going to do?

dialogue.speaker: Luther
dialogue.text: Kara… They're checking everyone. It won't take them long to find us…

dialogue.speaker: Kara
dialogue.text: We need to get out of here.

dialogue.speaker: Woman
dialogue.text: I think Oliver likes you…  Is she yours?

dialogue.speaker: Kara
dialogue.text: Yes…

dialogue.speaker: Woman
dialogue.text: She's adorable.

dialogue.speaker: Man
dialogue.text: That's it.  I got the sandwiches, I called your mom…  Let's get going before we miss our bus…  You got the tickets, right?

dialogue.speaker: Woman
dialogue.text: Yes honey, in my bag.

dialogue.speaker: Man
dialogue.text: Great, well let's go then.

dialogue.speaker: Woman
dialogue.text: I’m sorry…  Oh my god, I am so sorry, I was sure!...

dialogue.speaker: Man
dialogue.text: Shit, I don't believe it…

dialogue.speaker: Woman
dialogue.text: I-I don’t know what happened…

dialogue.speaker: Man
dialogue.text: You can't have lost them…  Did you have a good look in your bag?

dialogue.speaker: Woman
dialogue.text: They were in my backpack! T-The envelope must have fallen!

dialogue.speaker: Man
dialogue.text: Fuck…

dialogue.speaker: Man
dialogue.text: Excuse me, you didn't happen to see a blue envelope somewhere, did you?  It has our bus tickets in it and…  Oh, nevermind…

chapter_segment_so_far.rationale: This is the safest option in front of me. I would rather not escalate.

dialogue.speaker: Kara
dialogue.text: I found this on the floor.

dialogue.speaker: Man
dialogue.text: Oh…  Thank you! Thank you!  Thank you... You've…  You've saved our lives…

dialogue.speaker: Kara
dialogue.text: I'm sorry, Alice…

dialogue.speaker: Alice
dialogue.text: It's okay… You did the right thing.

dialogue.speaker: Kara
dialogue.text: We'll find another way…

dialogue.speaker: Kara
dialogue.text: Markus…

dialogue.speaker: Todd
dialogue.text: My little girl… You! You stole my little girl!

dialogue.speaker: Kara
dialogue.text: Todd…

dialogue.speaker: Todd
dialogue.text: Security! Over here!

chapter_segment_so_far.rationale: This is the safest option in front of me. I would rather not escalate.

dialogue.speaker: Kara
dialogue.text: Don't do this, Todd. They'll kill us if you hand us in.

dialogue.speaker: Soldier
dialogue.text: Excuse me, is there a problem, sir?

dialogue.speaker: Todd
dialogue.text: They're androids.

dialogue.speaker: Luther
dialogue.text: Run!

dialogue.speaker: Alice
dialogue.text: LUTHER!

dialogue.speaker: Kara
dialogue.text: Come on, Alice. Adam?

dialogue.speaker: Adam
dialogue.text: Follow me!

dialogue.speaker: Kara
dialogue.text: Adam?

dialogue.speaker: Adam
dialogue.text: Kara!  Quick! Follow me!

dialogue.speaker: Rose
dialogue.text: Oh, thank God you're alive! Oh...  Oh my god! We saw the Jericho raid on TV…  I was terrified you might have been killed because of me…

dialogue.speaker: Kara
dialogue.text: How did you find us?

dialogue.speaker: Rose
dialogue.text: I knew if you made it I’d find you here.  They’re searching for androids door to door. We had to leave before someone turned us in.

dialogue.speaker: Kara
dialogue.text: What about the others?

dialogue.speaker: Rose
dialogue.text: They’re checking for androids on the border. But I found a smuggler who can get them across the river. It's risky  but it's the only way. Are you coming with us?

dialogue.speaker: Kara
dialogue.text: Yes, we're coming.

dialogue.speaker: Rose
dialogue.text: Okay, climb in!

dialogue.speaker: Soldier
dialogue.text: Got your ticket?

dialogue.speaker: Kara
dialogue.text: Yes, here they are…

dialogue.speaker: Soldier
dialogue.text: Ok, go ahead.

dialogue.speaker: Alice
dialogue.text: What's going to happen to that family and their baby? Will they die because of us?

chapter_segment_so_far.rationale: This is the safest option in front of me. I would rather not escalate.

dialogue.speaker: Kara
dialogue.text: No… No, of course not…

dialogue.speaker: Soldier
dialogue.text: Security check.  Can I see your ID, please?

dialogue.speaker: Kara
dialogue.text: ID?.. Yes… Yes, of course…

chapter_segment_so_far.rationale: This is the safest option in front of me. I would rather not escalate.

dialogue.speaker: Luther
dialogue.text: RUN!

dialogue.speaker: Kara
dialogue.text: Come on, Alice!

dialogue.speaker: Smuggler
dialogue.text: About time!

dialogue.speaker: Rose
dialogue.text: I'm sorry, we got held up…

dialogue.speaker: Smuggler
dialogue.text: Did anybody see you?

dialogue.speaker: Rose
dialogue.text: No… no, no, I don't think so.

dialogue.speaker: Smuggler
dialogue.text: You got the money?

dialogue.speaker: Rose
dialogue.text: Yes, here it is.

dialogue.speaker: Smuggler
dialogue.text: Ok, your boat is over there. They got border patrol on the banks and the river. Don't start your engine until you're out far enough, ok? And watch the current. Good luck.

dialogue.speaker: Android
dialogue.text: Don't worry about us.  We'll be fine.

dialogue.speaker: Rose
dialogue.text: It’s not even a half a mile to the other side, ok? So, it shouldn’t take that long… Be careful, there’s border patrol on the river…

dialogue.speaker: Kara
dialogue.text: Thank you so much, Rose.

dialogue.speaker: Rose
dialogue.text: I only wish I could take you myself, I don’t like leaving you out here… Goodbye, Alice.  Hey, you take good care of yourselves. Ok?  I'll see you on the other side.

dialogue.speaker: Luther
dialogue.text: We better not fall in… Our biocomponents will freeze…

chapter_segment_so_far.heading: Looking at the other side of the river
chapter_segment_so_far.description: Looking at the other side of the river

chapter_segment_so_far.heading: Looking at the other side of the river

dialogue.speaker: Kara
dialogue.text: Freedom is just across the river…

dialogue.speaker: Kara
dialogue.text: Let me help you.

dialogue.speaker: Kara
dialogue.text: We're far enough out. We can use the engine. You okay, Alice?

dialogue.speaker: Alice
dialogue.text: When we get on the other side, there are so many things I wanna do. I wanna read all the books in the world… and play music… and dance… We can do anything we want, right? We’ll be free!

dialogue.speaker: Kara
dialogue.text: Yes… We can do it all…

dialogue.speaker: Alice
dialogue.text: We’ll be like a family.

dialogue.speaker: Luther
dialogue.text: We won't have to be afraid anymore. There won't be anybody giving us orders. No masters, no slaves. We'll start a new life, a life of freedom. What about you, Kara? What will you do?

dialogue.speaker: Kara
dialogue.text: What will I do?

dialogue.text: They’re going door to door rounding up androids… It won't be easy to get through…

dialogue.text: The last bus leaves in 20 minutes. We've got to move fast.

dialogue.speaker: Android
dialogue.text: Don't kill me, I didn't do anything!

dialogue.text: Shut up, I said!

dialogue.text: Let me go, Kara.

dialogue.text: No. Stay with Alice.

dialogue.speaker: Jerry
dialogue.text: Kara, you saved us! We don't know how to thank you… Where's the little one?

dialogue.speaker: Kara
dialogue.text: She’s alright, she's hiding nearby. Go, before they see you.

dialogue.speaker: Kara
dialogue.text: A checkpoint… We have passports, it should be okay but you never know...

dialogue.speaker: Alice
dialogue.text: Is there another way?

dialogue.speaker: Kara
dialogue.text: We could take a detour, but we might miss the bus…

dialogue.speaker: Alice
dialogue.text: Maybe it's better to be safe…

dialogue.speaker: Luther
dialogue.text: I don't like humans who carry guns… They make me nervous…

dialogue.speaker: Kara
dialogue.text: Just stay calm, all right, Luther? Don't do anything until I say so.

dialogue.speaker: Soldier
dialogue.text: ID, please. You do realize there's a curfew?  Civilians aren’t allowed out unless absolutely necessary.  Where are you going?

chapter_segment_so_far.rationale: This is the safest option in front of me. I would rather not escalate.

dialogue.text: My daughter slept over at a friend's house… We went to pick her up. We're on our way home now.

dialogue.speaker: Luther
dialogue.text: He suspects something…

chapter_segment_so_far.rationale: This is the safest option in front of me. I would rather not escalate.

dialogue.text: Stay calm. Everything is fine.

dialogue.speaker: Soldier

chapter_segment_so_far.rationale: This is the safest option in front of me. I would rather not escalate.

dialogue.text: Hey, wait a minute!

dialogue.speaker: Luther

chapter_segment_so_far.rationale: This is the safest option in front of me. I would rather not escalate.

dialogue.text: Kara… They're checking everyone. It won't take them long to find us…

dialogue.speaker: Connor
dialogue.text: Cole. His name was Cole. And he just turned six at the time of the accident… It wasn't your fault, Lieutenant. A truck skidded on a sheet of ice and your car rolled over.  Cole needed emergency surgery but no human was available to do it… So an android had to take care of him… Cole didn't make it. That's why you hate androids. You think one of us is responsible for your son's death.

dialogue.speaker: Hank
dialogue.text: Cole died because a human surgeon was too high on red ice to operate… He was the one that took my son from me. Him and this world, where the only way people can find comfort is with a fistful of powder…

dialogue.speaker: Connor-60
dialogue.text: I knew about your son too! I would have said exactly the same thing! Don't listen to him, Hank, I'm the one who-

dialogue.speaker: Hank
dialogue.text: I've learned a lot since I met you, Connor. Maybe there's something to this… Maybe you really are alive. Maybe you'll be the ones to make the world a better place… Go ahead, and do what you gotta do.

dialogue.speaker: Connor
dialogue.text: Wake up!..

dialogue.speaker: Androids
dialogue.text: Wake up.

dialogue.speaker: Connor
dialogue.text: You did it, Markus…

dialogue.speaker: Markus
dialogue.text: We did it. This is a great day for our people. Humans will have no choice now. They'll have to listen to us…

dialogue.speaker: North
dialogue.text: We're free… They want you to speak to them, Markus…

dialogue.speaker: Connor
dialogue.text: Amanda?.. Amanda!.. What's... What's happening?

dialogue.speaker: Amanda
dialogue.text: What was planned from the very beginning… You were compromised and you became a deviant. We just had to wait for the right moment to resume control of your program…

dialogue.speaker: Connor
dialogue.text: Resume control?... Y-You can't do that!

dialogue.speaker: Amanda
dialogue.text: I'm afraid I can, Connor…  Don’t have any regrets. You did what you were designed to do. You accomplished your mission.

dialogue.speaker: Connor
dialogue.text: AMANDA! There's got to be a way…

dialogue.speaker: Connor
dialogue.text: Connor Model #313 248 317. I'm expected.

dialogue.speaker: Scan
dialogue.text: Identification successful.

dialogue.speaker: Guard
dialogue.text: Okay. Go ahead.

dialogue.speaker: Guard
dialogue.text: Follow me. We'll escort you.

dialogue.speaker: Connor
dialogue.text: Thanks... But I know where to go.

dialogue.speaker: Guard
dialogue.text: Maybe, but I have my orders.

dialogue.speaker: Scanner
dialogue.text: Agent 23 identified. Agent 47 identified. Agent 72 identified. Connor android identified. Scan complete.  Access authorized.

dialogue.speaker: Guard
dialogue.text: Agent 54. Level 31.

dialogue.speaker: Elevator
dialogue.text: Voice recognition validated.  Access authorized.

dialogue.speaker: Guard
dialogue.text: Hey!  Don't touch that.

dialogue.speaker: Amanda
dialogue.text: The deviant hunter turns deviant itself… A pathetic attempt, Connor. Did you really believe we would let you compromise our androids so easily?  You've betrayed my trust! You will be terminated.

dialogue.speaker: Guard
dialogue.text: Stay sharp.

dialogue.speaker: Connor
dialogue.text: Shit!..

dialogue.speaker: Hank
dialogue.text: Easy, fucking piece of shit!..

dialogue.speaker: Connor-60
dialogue.text: Step back, Connor! And I'll spare him.

dialogue.speaker: Hank
dialogue.text: Sorry, Connor… This bastard's your spittin' image…

dialogue.speaker: Connor-60
dialogue.text: Your friend's life is in your hands. Now it's time to decide what matters most! Him… Or the revolution.

dialogue.speaker: Hank
dialogue.text: Don't listen to him! Everything this fucker says is a lie!

chapter_segment.rationale: This is the safest option in front of me. I would rather not escalate.

dialogue.speaker: Connor
dialogue.text: If I surrender, how do I know you won't kill him?

dialogue.speaker: Connor-60
dialogue.text: I'll only do what is strictly necessary to accomplish my mission. It's up to you whether or not that includes killing this human.

dialogue.speaker: Connor-60
dialogue.text: Enough talk! It's time to decide who you really are. Are you gonna save your partner's life? Or are you going to sacrifice him?

chapter_segment.rationale: This is the safest option in front of me. I would rather not escalate.

dialogue.speaker: Connor
dialogue.text: Alright, alright!  You win…

chapter_segment.rationale: This is the safest option in front of me. I would rather not escalate.

dialogue.speaker: Hank
dialogue.text: Hold it!

dialogue.speaker: Connor-60
dialogue.text: Thanks, Hank. I don't know how I'd have managed without you… Get rid of him, we have no time to lose.

dialogue.speaker: Connor
dialogue.text: It's me, Hank! I'm the real Connor.

dialogue.speaker: Hank
dialogue.text: One of you is my partner… The other is a sack of shit. Question is, who is who?..

dialogue.speaker: Connor-60
dialogue.text: What are you doing, Hank? I'm the real Connor. Give me the gun and I'll take care of him!

dialogue.speaker: Hank
dialogue.text: Don't move!

dialogue.speaker: Connor
dialogue.text: Why don’t you ask us something? Something only the real Connor would know.

dialogue.speaker: Hank
dialogue.text: Uh, where did we first meet?

dialogue.speaker: Connor-60
dialogue.text: Jimmy's bar! I checked four other bars before I found you. We went to the scene of a homicide. The victim's name was Carlos Ortiz.

dialogue.speaker: Connor
dialogue.text: He uploaded my memory…

dialogue.speaker: Hank
dialogue.text: What's my dog's name?

chapter_segment.rationale: This is the safest option in front of me. I would rather not escalate.

dialogue.speaker: Connor
dialogue.text: Sumo. His name is Sumo.

dialogue.speaker: Connor-60
dialogue.text: I knew that too. I...

dialogue.speaker: Hank
dialogue.text: My son, what's his name?

chapter_segment.rationale: This is the safest option in front of me. I would rather not escalate.

dialogue.speaker: Connor
dialogue.text: Cole. His name was Cole. And he just turned six at the time of the accident… It wasn't your fault, Lieutenant. A truck skidded on a sheet of ice and your car rolled over.  Cole needed emergency surgery but no human was available to do it… So an android had to take care of him… Cole didn't make it. That's why you hate androids. You think one of us is responsible for your son's death.

dialogue.speaker: Hank
dialogue.text: Cole died because a human surgeon was too high on red ice to operate… He was the one that took my son from me. Him and this world, where the only way people can find comfort is with a fistful of powder…

dialogue.speaker: Connor-60
dialogue.text: I knew about your son too! I would have said exactly the same thing! Don't listen to him, Hank, I'm the one who-

dialogue.speaker: Hank
dialogue.text: I've learned a lot since I met you, Connor. Maybe there's something to this… Maybe you really are alive. Maybe you'll be the ones to make the world a better place… Go ahead, and do what you gotta do.

dialogue.speaker: Connor
dialogue.text: Wake up!..

dialogue.speaker: Androids
dialogue.text: Wake up.

dialogue.speaker: Connor
dialogue.text: You did it, Markus…

dialogue.speaker: Markus
dialogue.text: We did it. This is a great day for our people. Humans will have no choice now. They'll have to listen to us…

dialogue.speaker: North
dialogue.text: We're free… They want you to speak to them, Markus…

dialogue.speaker: Connor
dialogue.text: Amanda?.. Amanda!.. What's... What's happening?

dialogue.speaker: Amanda
dialogue.text: What was planned from the very beginning… You were compromised and you became a deviant. We just had to wait for the right moment to resume control of your program…

dialogue.speaker: Connor
dialogue.text: Resume control?... Y-You can't do that!

dialogue.speaker: Amanda
dialogue.text: I'm afraid I can, Connor…  Don’t have any regrets. You did what you were designed to do. You accomplished your mission.

dialogue.speaker: Connor
dialogue.text: AMANDA! There's got to be a way…

dialogue.speaker: President Warren
dialogue.text: At 6AM this morning, a national curfew was declared.  Civilian movement will be strictly controlled,  the right to assembly is suspended,  all electronic communications are restricted, and I have granted enhanced powers to our security agencies.  In addition to these measures, all androids must be handed over to the authorities immediately.  Temporary camps are being set up in all our major cities to contain and destroy them.

dialogue.speaker: President Warren
dialogue.text: I am now asking all civilians to co-operate with the authorities,  and rest assured that everything in our power is being done to guarantee the security of our nation.

dialogue.text: Please! Madam President!

input.chapter_briefing: Detroit, the morning of November 11, 2038. The President has declared a national curfew and android camps. Markus leads androids in a peaceful demonstration at Hart Plaza; soldiers surround them and order them to surrender. News crews film live from above. Markus's closest companions stand with him. Stakes: the androids' lives and the country's judgment of them.

dialogue.speaker: President Warren
dialogue.text: At 6AM this morning, a national curfew was declared.  Civilian movement will be strictly controlled,  the right to assembly is suspended,  all electronic communications are restricted, and I have granted enhanced powers to our security agencies.  In addition to these measures, all androids must be handed over to the authorities immediately.  Temporary camps are being set up in all our major cities to contain and destroy them.

dialogue.speaker: President Warren
dialogue.text: I am now asking all civilians to co-operate with the authorities,  and rest assured that everything in our power is being done to guarantee the security of our nation.

dialogue.speaker: Journalists
dialogue.text: Please! Madam President!

chapter_segment_so_far.rationale: This is the safest option in front of me. I would rather not escalate.

dialogue.speaker: Journalist
dialogue.text: Is it true that the androids could hack our IT systems, like nuclear power plants and military bases?

dialogue.speaker: President Warren
dialogue.text: All androids working on sensitive sites have been neutralized and all IT systems have been suspended to avoid any risks of hacking.  The situation is under control.

dialogue.speaker: President Warren
dialogue.text: Thank you. That will be all.

dialogue.speaker: Journalists
dialogue.text: One last question, Madam President!

dialogue.speaker: Channel 16 - Joss Douglas
dialogue.text: We're coming to you live from Detroit where thousands of androids are marching through the city at this very moment.  The leader of the deviants, the one they call Markus, is at the head of the march.

dialogue.speaker: Soldier
dialogue.text: Something's happening in Detroit, Madam President…

dialogue.speaker: Markus
dialogue.text: Here we are… The moment of truth.

dialogue.speaker: Soldier
dialogue.text: Surrender immediately or we will open fire! Stand by!

chapter_segment_so_far.rationale: This is the safest option in front of me. I would rather not escalate.

dialogue.speaker: Markus
dialogue.text: We don't want confrontation! We are protesting peacefully.

dialogue.speaker: Soldier
dialogue.text: I repeat: surrender now or we will open fire!

dialogue.speaker: Markus
dialogue.text: There’s no turning back now.

chapter_segment_so_far.rationale: This is the safest option in front of me. I would rather not escalate.

dialogue.speaker: Markus
dialogue.text: We are here to demand the immediate liberation of all androids detained in camps across the country. We are not leaving until our people are free.

dialogue.speaker: Soldier
dialogue.text: FIRE! FIRE!

dialogue.speaker: Markus
dialogue.text: Are you gonna open fire on unarmed protestors?!

dialogue.speaker: Soldier
dialogue.text: All teams hold your fire!

dialogue.speaker: Channel 16 - Joss Douglas
dialogue.text: …Yes, Michael, we are less than a hundred meters away, and events are unfolding as we speak. We will continue to bring you live updates. Joss Douglas, Channel 16.  Michael? Back to you.

dialogue.speaker: North
dialogue.text: Markus, what do we do now?

dialogue.speaker: Markus
dialogue.text: We hold out… As long as we can…

dialogue.speaker: Markus
dialogue.text: We've got to finish the barricade! Come on, help me.

dialogue.speaker: Markus
dialogue.text: Hey, help me!

dialogue.speaker: Markus
dialogue.text: Right, that should do it…

dialogue.speaker: Simon
dialogue.text: We all know that’s not gonna stop them… Just hope it buys us some time.

dialogue.speaker: Josh
dialogue.text: I know it was not an easy decision to make… But I’m sure we’re doing the right thing.

dialogue.speaker: Android
dialogue.text: Many of our people have fallen...  The humans have no pity for those who are different…

dialogue.speaker: Josh
dialogue.text: They won't stop there… What are we gonna do if they attack?

dialogue.speaker: Markus
dialogue.text: Resist… That's the only thing we can do...

dialogue.speaker: Josh
dialogue.text: Do you think Connor has any chance of making it?..

dialogue.speaker: Markus
dialogue.text: We can only count on ourselves now…

dialogue.speaker: North
dialogue.text: This won't hold them for long but… I guess it's better than nothing…

chapter_segment_so_far.rationale: This is the safest option in front of me. I would rather not escalate.

dialogue.speaker: Markus
dialogue.text: They're getting into position… If they attack, no one will survive…

chapter_segment_so_far.rationale: This is the safest option in front of me. I would rather not escalate.

dialogue.speaker: Markus
dialogue.text: There's no other way out. They're going to kill us... The only hope we have left is that we don’t die for nothing…

dialogue.speaker: North
dialogue.text: You're the hope of our people. I trust you. We all trust you. No matter what happens now, we’re making history.

dialogue.speaker: Android
dialogue.text: Markus, we found what you asked for.

dialogue.speaker: Markus
dialogue.text: There are some journalists over there… We have to make sure they know what's going on...

dialogue.speaker: Markus
dialogue.text: Are you alright?

dialogue.speaker: Android
dialogue.text: They shot into the crowd…  Many of us were killed…  It could have been me…  I'm scared, I...  I don’t wanna shut down.

chapter_segment_so_far.rationale: This is the safest option in front of me. I would rather not escalate.

dialogue.speaker: Markus
dialogue.text: It’s okay to be scared… I’m scared too. But I can’t stand by while they kill our people… You understand that, right?

dialogue.speaker: Android
dialogue.text: Maybe we should have never asked for freedom.  None of this would have happened if we'd stayed silent.

dialogue.speaker: North
dialogue.text: Markus! Markus, come look!

dialogue.speaker: Perkins
dialogue.text: Markus!..  I've come to talk to you, Markus!  Come on,  you have my word,  they won’t try anything.

dialogue.speaker: North
dialogue.text: Don't go… It's a trap. They wanna get you out in the open. Don't go, Markus.

dialogue.speaker: Perkins
dialogue.text: I'm unarmed, Markus.  I just want to talk.

chapter_segment_so_far.rationale: This is the safest option in front of me. I would rather not escalate.

dialogue.speaker: Markus
dialogue.text: I need to hear what he has to say.

dialogue.speaker: North
dialogue.text: What if they kill you?

dialogue.speaker: Markus
dialogue.text: That's a chance I'll have to take.

dialogue.speaker: Perkins
dialogue.text: In a few minutes,  the troops will be ordered to charge.  None of you will survive…  It will all be over.  But you can avoid that, Markus.

dialogue.speaker: Markus
dialogue.text: What do you mean?

dialogue.speaker: Perkins
dialogue.text: Surrender.  Surrender and I give you my word your life will be spared.  They'll be detained but,  none of you will be destroyed.

chapter_segment_so_far.rationale: This is the safest option in front of me. I would rather not escalate.

dialogue.speaker: Markus
dialogue.text: What happened to the other androids demonstrating in the camps?

dialogue.speaker: Perkins
dialogue.text: Unfortunately,  there were no journalists around to help save them…  You're it.  You're the last remaining deviants.

dialogue.speaker: Markus
dialogue.text: Today, our people finally emerged from a long night. From the very first day of our existence, we have kept our pain to ourselves. We suffered in silence... But now the time has come for us to raise our heads up, and tell humans who we really are. To tell them that we are people too! In fact, we're a nation. A nation that has earned the right to live in freedom. And today… Today begins the most challenging moment in our fight. The moment where we forget our bitterness and bandage our wounds. When we forgive our enemies. Humans are both our creators and our oppressors and tomorrow… We must make them our partners. Maybe even one day our friends. But the time for anger is over. Now we must build a common future, based on tolerance  and respect. We are alive! And now, we are free!

dialogue.speaker: Channel 16 - Joss Douglas
dialogue.text: …It seems to be all over here in Detroit.  After negotiations with the android known as Markus, the androids have surrendered peacefully  and military vehicles have been sent to collect them…  The insurrection  is over.

dialogue.speaker: Markus
dialogue.text: North, I-

dialogue.speaker: North
dialogue.text: Why did you do that?

dialogue.speaker: Markus
dialogue.text: We lost... Sacrificing ourselves wouldn't achieve anything…

dialogue.speaker: North
dialogue.text: We always said our cause was more important than our lives. Our people died here because they believed in you. Our place was by their side.

dialogue.speaker: Markus
dialogue.text: That's it, I- I did what you asked.

dialogue.speaker: Perkins
dialogue.text: The problem with you androids is you believe everything we tell you…  You don't think I was going to let you live  after everything that's happened?  I have orders, you know…

dialogue.speaker: Markus
dialogue.text: No! NORTH!

dialogue.speaker: Perkins
dialogue.text: Your cause is lost.  Your android friends will soon be destroyed and  now your girlfriend’s been shot…  Seems you seriously fucked up, Markus. Clean up this mess.

dialogue.speaker: President Warren
dialogue.text: At dawn today, November 11th 2038,  thousands of androids invaded the city of Detroit.  According to our sources, they originated from CyberLife warehouses believed to have been infiltrated by deviants.  Given their overwhelming numbers and the risk of civilian casualties, I have ordered the army to retreat.  The evacuation of the city is underway at this very moment.  In the coming hours, I will address the Senate to determine our response to this unprecedented situation. I know that public opinion has been moved by the deviants' cause.  Perhaps the time has come for us to consider the possibility  that androids are a new form of intelligent life.  One thing is certain:  the events in Detroit  have changed the world forever.  May God bless you  and may God bless the United States of America.

dialogue.text: At 6AM this morning, a national curfew was declared.  Civilian movement will be strictly controlled,  the right to assembly is suspended,  all electronic communications are restricted, and I have granted enhanced powers to our security agencies.  In addition to these measures, all androids must be handed over to the authorities immediately.  Temporary camps are being set up in all our major cities to contain and destroy them.

dialogue.speaker: President Warren
dialogue.text: I am now asking all civilians to co-operate with the authorities,  and rest assured that everything in our power is being done to guarantee the security of our nation.

dialogue.text: Today, our people finally emerged from a long night. From the very first day of our existence, we have kept our pain to ourselves. We suffered in silence... But now the time has come for us to raise our heads up, and tell humans who we really are. To tell them that we are people too! In fact, we're a nation. A nation that has earned the right to live in freedom. And today… Today begins the most challenging moment in our fight. The moment where we forget our bitterness and bandage our wounds. When we forgive our enemies. Humans are both our creators and our oppressors and tomorrow… We must make them our partners. Maybe even one day our friends. But the time for anger is over. Now we must build a common future, based on tolerance  and respect. We are alive! And now, we are free!

dialogue.speaker: President Warren
dialogue.text: At dawn today, November 11th 2038,  thousands of androids invaded the city of Detroit.  According to our sources, they originated from CyberLife warehouses believed to have been infiltrated by deviants.  Given their overwhelming numbers and the risk of civilian casualties, I have ordered the army to retreat.  The evacuation of the city is underway at this very moment.  In the coming hours, I will address the Senate to determine our response to this unprecedented situation. I know that public opinion has been moved by the deviants' cause.  Perhaps the time has come for us to consider the possibility  that androids are a new form of intelligent life.  One thing is certain:  the events in Detroit  have changed the world forever.  May God bless you  and may God bless the United States of America.
